title: Ekhane Aakash Neel
summary: Ekhane Akash Neel is a Bengali romantic medical drama series that aired on Star Jalsha and streamed on the digital platform Hotstar from 23 September 2019. It was a reboot of the popular show Ekhane Aakash Neel (2008 TV series). It was also the remake of the StarPlus show Sanjivani (2019 TV series). Produced by Surinder Films, it starred Anamika Chakraborty as Dr. Hiya Mitra and Sean Banerjee as Dr. Ujaan Chatterjee. It ended on 3 October 2020 and was replaced by Ogo Nirupoma.
plot:
The story follows the characters Dr. Ujaan Chatterjee, one of the best five heart surgeons in the world, and Hiya Mitra, an aspiring doctor. Ujaan is ill-tempered and solely focused on work and does not believe in love, while Hiya is outgoing and compassionate and believes in love. Initially, Hiya comes to Kolkata to attend the city's top medical college, Tulip. The college was a part of Tulip Hospital, owned by Ujaan's father, Dr. Samaresh Chatterjee. However, unable to pay the high fees, Hiya returns to her home village. Still passionate about helping people, Hiya begins working at a health camp in the village.
At the health camp, Hiya encounters Dr. Samaresh Chatterjee, who was suffering from longstanding knee pain. Hiya volunteers to cure Samaresh pain with ayurvedic treatment. Intrigued by Hiya's enthusiasm, Dr. Chatterjee invites her to his home in Kolkata for his treatment. There, Hiya is delighted to meet Dr. Ujaan Chatterjee and immediately idolizes him as her "guru," or greatest teacher. Ujaan, on the contrary, is disgusted to encounter such a talkative, interfering girl.
Time passes and Hiya and Ujaan grow close. Hiya is supposed to leave Kolkata after successfully curing Dr. Samaresh after a period of 10 days. However, she accidentally gets into the expired medicine racquet of Ujaan's step-brother Bihaan and she is accused with attempt to murder the patients. She is publicly humiliated and arrested. However, it does not sit right in Ujaan's heart and he proves her innocent.
After some time, Ujaan and Hiya become close, and Ujaan begins to feel destined to be with Hiya. However, Ujaan refuses to acknowledge this, as when he was a child, his father abandoned his mother, Basobi Chatterjee, and remarried Meenakshi. Growing up, Ujaan had to live separated from his mother, with the assumed identity of his father's adopted child. This greatly pained Ujaan, but he never exposed his feelings. Hiya becomes aware of this and tries to bring his mother back to him. Just as Ujaan is ready to express his true feelings for Hiya, she leaves him saying that she had never loved him. However, the truth is that she had incurable heart disease and believed Ujaan would not be able to bear this news.
Ujaan is heartbroken. At this time, Dr. Jhinuk Sen enters Tulip Hospital. She had escaped from her psychologically abusive fiancé along with his daughter Ollie, from his first wife.
Ujaan develops a bond with Oli after learning about her father's abusive nature, so he enters into a fake marriage arrangement with Jhinuk Sen for six months to protect her.
Hiya again encounters Ujaan at Tulip in spite of trying hard not to meet him. They get married and Ujaan successfully operates on Hiya, curing her of heart disease. Jhinuk Sen is acting like a psychopath because of Bihaan's wrong medicine but later she intentionally tries to separate Hiya from Ujaan's life and get permanent entry into his life. Even she tries to kill Hiya. A few days later, they reveal their marriage to everyone. Meanwhile, Ujaan's younger stepbrother Bihaan kills Dr. Jhinuk Sen whom he had mistaken for Hiya and drugged. Bihaan is arrested along with Meenakshi who had made several attempts in the past to harm Hiya. Nilima, who had earlier intended to marry Ujaan and had tried to destroy Hiya and Ujaan's relationship, becomes friendly. A few years later, Hiya becomes a doctor at Tulip Hospital. The season concludes as Hiya and Ujaan welcome their new daughter, Hiyaan.

plotHtml:
The story follows the characters Dr. Ujaan Chatterjee, one of the best five heart surgeons in the world, and Hiya Mitra, an aspiring doctor. Ujaan is ill-tempered and solely focused on work and does not believe in love, while Hiya is outgoing and compassionate and believes in love. Initially, Hiya comes to Kolkata to attend the city's top medical college, Tulip. The college was a part of Tulip Hospital, owned by Ujaan's father, Dr. Samaresh Chatterjee. However, unable to pay the high fees, Hiya returns to her home village. Still passionate about helping people, Hiya begins working at a health camp in the village.
At the health camp, Hiya encounters Dr. Samaresh Chatterjee, who was suffering from longstanding knee pain. Hiya volunteers to cure Samaresh pain with ayurvedic treatment. Intrigued by Hiya's enthusiasm, Dr. Chatterjee invites her to his home in Kolkata for his treatment. There, Hiya is delighted to meet Dr. Ujaan Chatterjee and immediately idolizes him as her "guru," or greatest teacher. Ujaan, on the contrary, is disgusted to encounter such a talkative, interfering girl.
Time passes and Hiya and Ujaan grow close. Hiya is supposed to leave Kolkata after successfully curing Dr. Samaresh after a period of 10 days. However, she accidentally gets into the expired medicine racquet of Ujaan's step-brother Bihaan and she is accused with attempt to murder the patients. She is publicly humiliated and arrested. However, it does not sit right in Ujaan's heart and he proves her innocent.
After some time, Ujaan and Hiya become close, and Ujaan begins to feel destined to be with Hiya. However, Ujaan refuses to acknowledge this, as when he was a child, his father abandoned his mother, Basobi Chatterjee, and remarried Meenakshi. Growing up, Ujaan had to live separated from his mother, with the assumed identity of his father's adopted child. This greatly pained Ujaan, but he never exposed his feelings. Hiya becomes aware of this and tries to bring his mother back to him. Just as Ujaan is ready to express his true feelings for Hiya, she leaves him saying that she had never loved him. However, the truth is that she had incurable heart disease and believed Ujaan would not be able to bear this news.
Ujaan is heartbroken. At this time, Dr. Jhinuk Sen enters Tulip Hospital. She had escaped from her psychologically abusive fiancé along with his daughter Ollie, from his first wife.
Ujaan develops a bond with Oli after learning about her father's abusive nature, so he enters into a fake marriage arrangement with Jhinuk Sen for six months to protect her.
Hiya again encounters Ujaan at Tulip in spite of trying hard not to meet him. They get married and Ujaan successfully operates on Hiya, curing her of heart disease. Jhinuk Sen is acting like a psychopath because of Bihaan's wrong medicine but later she intentionally tries to separate Hiya from Ujaan's life and get permanent entry into his life. Even she tries to kill Hiya. A few days later, they reveal their marriage to everyone. Meanwhile, Ujaan's younger stepbrother Bihaan kills Dr. Jhinuk Sen whom he had mistaken for Hiya and drugged. Bihaan is arrested along with Meenakshi who had made several attempts in the past to harm Hiya. Nilima, who had earlier intended to marry Ujaan and had tried to destroy Hiya and Ujaan's relationship, becomes friendly. A few years later, Hiya becomes a doctor at Tulip Hospital. The season concludes as Hiya and Ujaan welcome their new daughter, Hiyaan.

title: Ek Bhram...Sarvagun Sampanna
summary: Ek Bhram...Sarvagun Sampanna is an Indian thriller drama television series that aired on StarPlus from 22 April to 20 September 2019. Produced by Sunny Side Up Films, it starred Shrenu Parikh and Zain Imam.
plot:
Janhvi is the respected and accomplished ideal daughter-in-law of the rich Mittal family. Loved by everyone, her decisions are always respected. But Janhvi has a secret vengeance towards the family. PK's younger son, Kabir Mittal is an army officer who returns home after six years with the widow and son of his colleague who sacrifice his life for the nation.
Janhvi reveals herself to be Pooja Sharma, the daughter of Dr. Ashok Sharma. Ashok's house was burnt by PK Mittal. The former managed to save his daughters but died in the fire. Since then Pooja vowed to destroy the whole Mittal family. She got the entire Mittal business and property on her name and ousted the Mittal family from their home.
Thus, starts a cold war between Pooja and Kabir. Kabir kidnaps Pooja's mother and asks Pooja to marry him in order to save her mother's life. Helpless, Pooja agrees and the two get married. Slowly, the two see each other's good side thus softening towards one another. Hesitant at first, they later accept having fallen in love with each other. Evil Rani turns vengeful towards Pooja, unable to accept Kabir with someone else. Eventually, Pooja and Kabir clear through all the plotting and misunderstandings and unite.
reception:
Times Now said, "While it’s very clear in the first episode itself how twisted Janhvi is, makers keep the intrigue alive with her character. While Shrenu keeps the intrigue alive with her antics in the show, Zain’s character, Kabir, also manages to add to all the drama right before the episode ends".
The Times of India stated, "Ek Bhram – Sarvagun Sampanna will keep you hooked to the show with Janhvi’s mysterious unsettled scores".
India Today said, "Shrenu Parikh is quite convincing as Janhvi, who can deceive anyone with her perfect bahu act. Ayub Khan fits well into the role of a strict head of the family. Ek Bhram – Sarvagun Sampanna looks promising and will keep the viewers hooked with its interesting twists and turns".

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text:
The show was launched in a 1000-year-old heritage called Saas–Bahu temple located in Udaipur, Rajasthan.
The initial sequences of the series were inspired from real life incidents of a highly influential Indian family whom the makers maintained confidential. Due to this, they received threat phone calls from some of the families fearing threat to their identity.
In June 2019, the show went through a revamp in its storyline to increase the very low ratings, due to which actors Ayub Khan and Tanvi Dogra who were playing PK Mittal and Kavya Mittal respectively had to exit the show. Speaking about it producer Dipti Kalwani said, "The show is going in for a revamp with the existing cast. Actors are not quitting and will be brought back soon".

articleSections.title: Cancellation
articleSections.text: Despite the revamp in June 2019, the ratings did not reach expectations and thus, the shoot of the series concluded on 13 September 2019 while the series aired its last episode on 20 September 2019.

title: Ek Thi Rani Ek Tha Raavan
wikiTitle: Ek Thi Rani Ek Tha Raavan
summary: Ek Thi Rani Ek Tha Raavan (transl. Once there was a Queen and a Villain) is an Indian Hindi-language drama television series that premiered from 21 January 2019 to 21 September 2019 on Star Bharat and is digitally available on Disney+ Hotstar. An adaptation of Darr, it starred Ram Yashvardhan, Manul Chudasama and Sheezan Khan.
plot:
The story revolves around Rani and her stalker Rivaaj. Rivaaj saw Rani at the college and instantly fell for her courageous nature. Ever since Rivaaj keeping Stalking Rani. Rivaaj propose Rani which she rejects. Out of frustration Rivaaj decided to marry Rani's sister Rukmini. Rivaaj plans to switch brides during the wedding to marry Rani. However his plan backfires and Rani marries Rivaaj mentally delayed brother Raghav.
Rivaaj tries everything he can to obtain Rani. When all his attempts backfired, Rivaaj burned Raghav and Rani Alive. Raghav died and Rani survived. Rani underwent plastic surgery and comes back under the name Mayura. Ruvaaj has become a successful actor. Mayura becomes Rivaaj's person bodyguard. Eventually after a lot of efforts Mayura burned Rivaaj in the same warehouse he burned Rani and Raghav.

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text: The series was announced in 2019 by Star Bharat, an official television adaptation of the 1993 Hindi film Darr. The promos were released in December 2018. Ram Yashvardhan was cast in the titular role, and was joined by Manul Chudasama and Sheezan Khan as leads. was replaced overnight with Srishti Jain. Natasha Singh was cast to portray the negative lead. Mahek Chahal had a cameo appearance in the show, but later replaced with Sara Khan. It premeried on Star Bharat from 21 January 2019 and went off-air within 9 months on 21 September 2019, due to low viewership.

title: Ekkadiki Ee Parugu
summary:
Ekkadiki Ee Parugu is a 2019 Indian Telugu-language web series starring Aryan Rajesh, Shashank, Pavani Gangireddy, Kalpika Ganesh and Chandra Vempaty . It was directed by Abhilash Reddy Kankara. The premise of this thriller drama which revolves around Madhur Anand (Shashank), a popular chef, whose wife Vaishnavi (Pavani) goes missing. The investigating officer (Aryan Rajesh), who himself is recovering from the recent death of his wife, suspects Madhur to be the perpetrator.
The series premiered on ZEE5 to positive reviews. It was dubbed and released in Tamil as Thadam.
plot: Madhur Anand, a renowned chef, files a police complaint that his wife, Vaishnavi has gone missing. The investigating police officer who himself is recovering from the recent death of his wife suspects foul play, but he doesn't know if he has enough clues to suspect anyone yet. When he begins to investigate the case, things go terribly wrong when he discovers that Madhur Anand might be lying. If this is not enough, Madhur himself sets out to unravel the mystery about Vaishnavi's life just before her death. The rest of the story is about finding who killed Vaishnavi and what were the circumstances that led to her death.
reception: Hemanth Kumar of Firstpost praised the performances of Aryan Rajesh and Pavani Gangireddy but termed it a convoluted web-series and said it would have been better as a film, as the director's initial intention. He criticised the narrative and said that the performances in a few scenes were amateurish, but it worked well in its emotional scenes.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: The web series was released on online streaming platform Zee5 on January 8, 2019.

title: Eeramana Rojave
summary:
Eeramana Rojave (transl. The Wet Rose) is a 2018–2023 Indian Tamil language romantic drama television series, aired on Star Vijay. The show is produced by Signature Productions and has two seasons.
The first season starring Pavithra Janani, Dhiraviam Rajkumaran, Shyam, Sai Gayatri Bhuvanesh, Praveen Devasagayam and Archana Kumar and directed by Francis Kathiravan, Rishi and Ravi Priyan. The show was aired from 9 July 2018 to 14 August 2021 for 807 episodes. The second season premiered on 17 January 2022 and ended on 2 December 2023 with 502 episodes, and aired on Monday to Saturday at night, starring Dhiraviam Rajakumaran, Swathi Konde, Sidharth Kumaaran and Gabriella Charlton.

title: Enkitta Modhaade
summary: Enkitta Modhaade  is a 2018-2019 Tamil reality game show that aired on Vijay TV and digitally streams on Disney+ Hotstar. The show features Vijay TV's soap opera families in which the actors will compete in a number of entertainment based challenges. The show has currently entered the second season. The first season aired from 21 April 2018 to 14 July 2018. The first episode of the second season aired on 19 May 2019. The show is hosted by  Dhivyadharshini.

title: Eken Babu
summary: Eken Babu is a Bengali-language web series streaming on Hoichoi. The web series is based on Ekenbabu detective story, which is written by Sujan Dasgupta Anirban Chakraborti plays the title role, with Shuhotro Mukhopadhay and Somak Ghosh in supporting roles.

articleSections.title: Season  1 (2018)
articleSections.text: The first season is directed by Anirban Mallik, it streamed on Bengali OTT platform hoichoi from 3 March 2018. It was based on the story "Manhattane Moonstone".

articleSections.title: Season 2 (2018)
articleSections.text: The second season released on 10 November 2018; all the episodes were directed by Anupam Hari. The story is based on "Manhattan ey Man hunt".

articleSections.title: Season 3 (2019)
articleSections.text: The third season aired on 28 November 2019; all the five episodes were directed by Abhijit Chowdhury. The story is set in Bangladesh, and most of the shooting is also done in Bangladesh. It was based on the story, "Dhaka Rahasyo Unmochito".

articleSections.title: Season 4 (2020)
articleSections.text: On 2 October 2020, hoichoi released Season 4 with six new episodes directed by Joydip Mukherjee and Surajit Chatterjee. It was based on the story "Ekenbabu O Barman Bari Rahasya".

articleSections.title: Season 5 (2021)
articleSections.text: On 8 October 2021, hoichoi released Season 5 with six new episodes directed by Anirban Mullick. It is based on the story, "Sankhyar Sanket". Eken Babu season 5, titled "Eken Babu: Santiniketan Shanket Mochon,"

articleSections.title: Season 6 (2022)
articleSections.text: On 20 September 2022, hoichoi announced Season 6. The series started streaming from 23 December 2022. It was based on the story "Asol Khunir Sondhane". From this season the actors of the role of both Bapi and Promotho were changed.Eken Babu season 6, titled "Eken Babu Ebar Kolkatay".

articleSections.title: Season 7 (2023)
articleSections.text: Eken Babu season 7, titled "Tungkulung E Eken," premiered on December 8th, 2023. The season follows Eken Babu, Bapi, and Promotho on vacation in Tungkulung."Tungkulung E Eken" is based on the detective story "Khuner Age Khuni Khoja".

articleSections.title: Season 8 (2025)
articleSections.text: The eight season is titled "Puro Puri Eken". As title suggests, the story is based on Puri. The series is based on the story "Nrityoshilpir Mrityu Tadonte Ekenbabu".

articleSections.title: Season 9 (2026)
articleSections.text: Eken babu's season 9 is set in Purulia. The series released on 15 April 2026, coinciding with the occasion of Poila Baishakh. The series is based on Sujan Dasgupta's Ekenbabu story, Bhoyonkor Chithi. The pre-credits scene of the final episode announced the next instalment of the film franchise, The Eken: Keralay Kurukkhetro that will be releasing on Durga Pujo 2026.

articleSections.title: Dubbed version
articleSections.text: From November 2025 to December 2025 Sony SAB released Eken Babu in Hindi dub.

The film released in theatres on 14 April 2022. The film was shot in the hill station of Darjeeling. It was based on the story "Manhattaner Madman".
On 1 November 2022, SVF announced the second film, which will be shot in December 2022, in Rajasthan. Titled The Eken: Ruddhaswas Rajasthan and directed by Joydip Mukherjee, the movie stars Anirban Chakrabarti, Suhotra Mukhopadhyay, Somak Ghosh, Sandipta Sen and Rajatava Dutta in central roles. The film released in theatres worldwide on 14 April 2023. It was loosely based on the story "Sosommane Bidai".
The third film titled The Eken: Benaras e Bibhishika was announced on January 2025. The film is directed by Joydip Mukherjee and produced by Shrikant Mohta and Mahendra Soni under the banner of Shree Venkatesh Films and Hoichoi Studios. It was released in the theatres on 16 May 2025. It is based on the novel "Ideal Jewellery".
The Fourth Film The Eken: Keralay Kurukshetra is set to release during Durga Puja on October 16, 2026.

articleSections.title: Description
articleSections.text:
Entertainment Ki Raat is latest reality TV show by Colors TV. Entertainment Ki Raat show has all kinds of entertaining segments including stand-up comedy, musical rapping, drop the mic, celebrity chat segment and many more, the show will prove to be an entertainment variety show.
The Tribune described the show as follows: "With its unique format that combines fiction and non-fiction, the show offers an array of components. From musical games to dance-offs to antakshari, the show has a lot to offer. The cook-offs will bring in some delicious moments, while the hidden camera pranks on celebrities are part of this show as well."

title: Ek Deewaana Tha
summary:
Ek Deewaana Tha (transl. There was a lover) is an Indian horror thriller television show which was broadcast on Sony Entertainment Television from 23 October 2017 to 1 June 2018. The show was created by Prateek Sharma and produced by LSD Films Private Limited.
The series starred Namik Paul,  Vikram Singh Chauhan and Donal Bisht.
plot:
In a fatal accident, Sharanya ends up in a coma. After 2 years, When she wakes up, she has no memory of the last 3 years. Vyom introduced himself to be her boyfriend. After strange incidents spontaneously threaten Vyom's life caused by a spirit, Sharanya decides to marry Vyom to save his life angering the spirit. As they get married, the spirit kills Sharanya's father. The spirit attacks and injures Vyom again and again, and Sharanya goes to Kapali Hills to find out how she can protect Vyom. There she discovers Shiv’s (the spirit) dead body.
Sharanya tries to prove Vyom's crimes, his mother Madhvi takes the blame and arrested. Vyom's father Rajan Bedi wants his wife released so he fake his death and put the blame on him thus procuring Madhvi's release.
Vyom called Odhni to get rid of Shiv's spirit and, on her advice, Shiv's mother Swarna to get Sharanya to perform Shiv's last rites and burn all his belongings. Sharanya sees Rajan and Madhvi together and confronts Vyom. Vyom is forced to admit his crime - the murder of Shiv's father (to protect his own parents).
Sharanya tells him that she could never love him and prepares to leave but Rajan told Sharanya to give him Shiv's ring so he can get rid of Shiv's spirit for good. But before she can remove it, Swarna pushes her off a cliff to her death.
About to kill Swarna, a distraught Vyom instead kills himself.

articleSections.title: 25 years later
articleSections.text:
Rajan and Madhvi are raising a girl named Shivani who returns from London with her boyfriend Akash who is Vyom's lookalike and whose mannerisms also remind Rajan of Vyom.
Shivani and Akash decide to get engaged and at their engagement party, Akash surprises her with her favourite superstar Krrish Khanna (KK) who is Shiv's lookalike. Then they meet Radhika at their film shooting who is Sharanya's lookalike.
Swarna reveals that Radhika is Sharanya's reincarnation and that Odhni and Swarna swapped the babies because Rajan and Madhvi wanted to adopt the girl expected to be Sharanya's reincarnation.
Krish and Radhika see Swarna and try to help her. Meanwhile, at Akash and Shivani's wedding, Akash is revealed to be Vyom. Swarna had prevented him from killing himself declaring it his punishment to stay alive. Akash described his true identity as Vyom and his story.
Shivani has gone missing and Radhika takes her place in the film. Krish convinces Radhika to join the film as they continue searching for Shivani. Radhika hears Shivani's phone ringing in the basement and goes there to find her but is confronted by Freddy and faints on seeing him. She awakens in her bed and is told by Akash that Rajan and Madhavi are in Manali to look for Shivani. However, Radhika shows Krish Freddy's shirt button to prove to him that she did see him in the basement.
Radhika and Krish go to the basement to find Shivani but are overpowered by Freddy. Radhika recall her past life that she remembers being in love with Vyom. Krish is shocked but Vyom is overjoyed to finally get Sharanya. But she is lying to find Swarna, Rajan and Madhvi. Krish tricks him into killing Freddy. Vyom commits suicide by jumping off a cliff.
Krish and Radhika are united, however it is not without obstacles; Vyom's spirit returns as he was deewana of Sharanya, is deewana of Sharanya and will be deewana of Sharanya.

episodesList.title: Vyom's Prayers Are Answered
episodesList.summary: Sharanya has been in coma for close to two years. The doctor informs Mrs. Bhist that Sharanya’s recovery is highly unlikely. Then, a miracle occurs and Sharanya regains consciousness. When Vyom arrives at the hosptial, Mrs. Bhist credits Vyom for Sharanya’s successful recovery. That night, Sharanya wakes up from sleep and walks towards the terrace. Who is calling Sharanya?

episodesList.title: Sharanya's Memory Loss
episodesList.summary: Vyom informs Sharanya that until his last breath she will be with him; without her he is nothing and no one can separate them. He is surprised when Sharanya claims that she does not know him. Later, the doctor informs Sharanya that due to her accident she has memory loss.

episodesList.title: Vyom's Wait Continues
episodesList.summary: The doctor assures Vyom that gradually Sharanya will recover. That night, Sharanya wakes up and goes out of her ward. In the dark, cold night, Sharanya feels the presence of an entity. Before the entity can make its presence felt to Sharanya, she bumps into Vyom. Will Sharanya remember her past with Vyom?

episodesList.title: Stargazers
episodesList.summary: Sharanya informs Vyom that her favorite flowers are stargazers. Vyom decides to find the particular flowers for Sharanya but learns that it is not the flowering season. Then, Vyom is shocked to see stargazer flowers in Sharanya’s ward. Then, suddenly, Sharanya runs out of the hospital and asks her family members to take her home.

episodesList.title: Home Sweet Home
episodesList.summary: Sharanya returns home and is welcomed by her family, who show her the new room. Sharanya’s family members ask Vyom to resume his singing now that Sharanya is hail and hearty.

episodesList.title: Mysterious Presence
episodesList.summary: Sharanya does not realize that the man who was holding her hand at the hospital was not Vyom. She tells Vyom that she does not love him but Vyom agrees to wait until she regains her memory and realizes her love for him. Sharanya continues to experience the inexpiable activity around her as Vyom also begins to feel the eeriness.

episodesList.title: Hallucinations
episodesList.summary: Sharanya tells Vyom that she does not need him anymore and he should leave her house. Vyom decides to leave even though Sharanya’s parents want him to stay. Sharanya is still in fear of the shadow that has been haunting her. Sharanya’s brother explains to her that what she is experiencing are the side effects of the medications of she is taking. Will Sharanya’s eerie feeling come to an end?

episodesList.title: Memories
episodesList.summary: Vyom remembers the time he spent with Sharanya. Meanwhile, Sharanya is still bothered by the eerie situations she is coming across. She is terrified and hides under a blanket to make herself comfortable. Then, she remembers the ill-fated accident, which rewrote her fate.

episodesList.title: Riddles of the Past
episodesList.summary: Sharanya visits the accident site, which she was having visions about. Vyom arrives as a tree falls on Sharanya. Though Sharanya escapes unhurt, Vyom feels she could have the avoided the situation in the first place. Sharanya, instead of being thankful to Vyom, shouts at him and asks him to leave as soon as they reach home. Now Sharanya is detrmined more than ever to solve the riddles of her past.

episodesList.title: Cold Dark Night
episodesList.summary: Sharanya and her family arrive at Vyom’s residence for the party. But, Sharanya is hesitant to step inside fearing that something is strange about the place. After being convinced by her parents, Sharanya agrees to come. Shortly after the party beings, the lights go out and Sharanya goes missing? Where is Sharanya?

episodesList.title: Ominous Presence
episodesList.summary: Vyom finds Sharanya unconscious and takes her inside. The next day, the doctor asks Sharanya to take plenty of rest and informs her family that Sharanya is merely stressed out. But, what the family members, Vyom, and Sharanya herself do not realise is the presence of the entity which has been following her.

episodesList.title: Nightmare
episodesList.summary: Sharanya and Vyom finally get close to each other as Vyom’s ladylove ties a friendship band on Vyom’s wrist. The ominous entity around Sharanya is not pleased. It makes sure the friendship band does not stay on Vyom’s wrist for long. That night, as Sharanya goes to the kitchen, she is stabbed by the entity. Is this a dream or a reality?

episodesList.title: Sharanya's Hallucination
episodesList.summary: Vyom wakes up from a nightmare, in which he saw Sharanya’s death. Meanwhile, Sharanya sees blood and calls her parents terrified. But, none of her family members see any trace of blood. Later, the psychiatrist calls up Sharanya and asks her to meet him alone.

episodesList.title: Fear
episodesList.summary: Sharanya is terrified after seeing Dr. Amit dead. The police arrive at the crime scene and question Sharanya presuming that she might know the identity of the killer. The next day. Sharanya and Vyom visit the police station and Vyom gets into a confrontation with the police. Realizing that he might have to start an investigation of his own, he takes Sharaya to the crime scene to uncover the truth?

episodesList.title: Vyom Meets With an Accident
episodesList.summary: Sharanya tells Vyom that if he stays with her, she will remember her past. This makes the spirit following Sharanya unhappy. It tries to separate them by hurting Vyom. Sharanya while trying to help Vyom comes across a woman who wants to inform her about the spirit. Will Sharanya and Vyom finally realize the presence of the spirit?

episodesList.title: Vyoms Life Under Threat
episodesList.summary: Vyom’s father puts forth marriage proposal before Sharanya, but she rejects the proposal. Before leaving she meets Vyom, who asks her to stay back. Moments later, Sharanya notices that blood coming out of Vyom’s veins. Is Vyom’s life under threat?

episodesList.title: Vyom's Life Under Threat
episodesList.summary: Vyom’s mother tries to put the blame of Vyom’s accident on Sharanya. When Sharanya tries to leave, Vyom stops her. Vyom tries to remind her of the memories they have shared together. Will Sharanya remember the past?

episodesList.title: Shadows
episodesList.summary: Sharanya is relived that Vyom is recovering. Vyom informs her that Dr. Amit was accused of harassment. Sharanya is in disbelief and blames herself for having trusted him. She finds solace in Vyom’s company but the ominous entity following her does not like it. What happens next,

episodesList.title: The Secret
episodesList.summary: Seeing Vyom and Sharanya close together, the ominous entity hurts Vyom. The family members rush to Vyom’s aid and call a doctor to help him recover. Sharanya then sets out to find the secret buried at Kapali Hills. What happens next,

episodesList.title: Nightmare
episodesList.summary: Sharanya wakes up from a nightmare. She decides to find the clairvoyant in order to find answers to her puzzling past. However, her father does not want her to visit the clairvoyant. Unknown to them, the ominous entity following Sharanya has entered their house. What happens next,

episodesList.title: He Rises from the Shadows
episodesList.summary: Sharanya calls up Vyom and informs him that she is afraid. Vyom does what he can to pacify Sharanya. Then, Sharanya goes to the clairvoyant to find answers to her past. What happens next,

episodesList.title: The Separation
episodesList.summary: Vyom takes Sharanya home after her visit to the clairvoyant. Sharanya shouts at him and asks him to leave. She does not want Vyom to suffer for her anymore. Will Vyom give up so easily?

episodesList.title: Vyom Sharanya's Fight
episodesList.summary: Odhni looks at Shiv’s sketch on the wall and tries to click a picture of it on her phone but nothing appears in the picture. Shiv leans closer to Sharanya but is diverted by the sound of blaring horn of Vyom's car. Vyom wants to talk to Sharanya. Sharanya's father knocks her door but she doesn't come out. Bishts head back to the door. Vyom understands that she isn’t coming but he is not at all willing to give up.

episodesList.title: Sharanya Leaves Masuri
episodesList.summary: Sharanya’s parents tell Vyom to look after him. Vyom takes Sharanya home with him. Shiv stares as they leave. Vyom and Sharanya come close to each other once again but Sharanya starts to feel that everything that's happening to Vyom is because of her. So she gives Vyom painkillers and he falls asleep. She comes back to her house and starts packing the bags to leave without telling Vyom where she was going.

episodesList.title: Vyom Losses Temper
episodesList.summary: Sharanya tells the spirit to go away now. Bishts run outside to stop her but she doesn't. They both cry and Vyom asks her not to go and tells her that he loves her and she is the only reason for living right now for him. Sharanya stops at a temple when it looks familiar to her. She prays for her family's well being and safety in her absence. She also prays for Vyom to give him the strength to carry on his life.

episodesList.title: Vyom Fights
episodesList.summary: Sharanya tells the spirit to go away now. Bishts run outside to stop her but she doesn't. They both cry and Vyom asks her not to go and tells her that he loves her and she is the only reason for living right now for him. Sharanya stops at a temple when it looks familiar to her. She prays for her family's well being and safety in her absence. She also prays for Vyom to give him the strength to carry on his life.

episodesList.title: Vyom Attempts Suicide
episodesList.summary: Vyom gets seriously injured as he attempted suicide. Meanwhile Shiv arrives in the operation theatre to kill Vyom. Sharanya tells that she decided to leave Vyom to keep him safe. Sharanya tells that when she refused Vyom, he jumped from the building. Will Shiv be able to kill Vyom?

episodesList.title: Marriage Proposal
episodesList.summary: Shiv steps out of Vyom’s ward angrily. Lights begin to flicker and even the machines react to the switch in voltage. Everyone is boggled to see it. All the patients, visitors, and hospital staff are shocked. Doctor asks Sharanya and everyone to leave but she refuses to leave his side. Shiv is also in the room where Vyom is. All efforts of Sharanya to get help for Vyom go in vain. Vyom continues to shiver. She notices a cylinder there and breaks the glass on the door.

episodesList.title: Imperfect Kundali
episodesList.summary: Sharanya is about to sit in the front seat when she notices the cold wind around her. Shiv is standing very close to her. She realizes this and sit in the back seat of the car with Vyom and doesn't leave him alone. The priest reads Sharanya's Kundali and says that she is a very nice girl but the problem is that if she marries the person she loves, that person's life will always be in danger.

episodesList.title: Calm Before the Storm
episodesList.summary: Rajan brings Vyom home. The mystery behind his sudden recovery has perplexed the father and son. Rajan is disappointed that Vyom tried to commit suicide. Later, the family members forget about the incident and begin preparations for a new beginning in Vyom and Sharanya’s life. But, will the ominous entity following Sharanya let this happen?

episodesList.title: Death Comes Knocking
episodesList.summary: The clairvoyant meets Rajan to inform him about the impending threat to Vyom’s life. Rajan makes the mistake of not paying heed to her advice. Later, during the engagement ceremony, the lights suddenly go off. After a while, Vyom is dragged outside the house and an unexpected twist shocks Rajan and Sharanya.

episodesList.title: The Ring
episodesList.summary: Sharanya sees Vyom’s horrible death only to realize its a daydream. Rajan wants to finish off with the formalities and get the engagement done with. Sharanya pleads before the gods for Vyom’s safety. After the engagement Sharanya realizes that the ghost is trying to take away her engagement ring.

episodesList.title: The Looming Threat
episodesList.summary: The engagement ring is in the hands of Shiv, who crushes it to pieces. Sharanya realizes that she has minutes to rescue Vyom, whose life is in danger from Vyom. Will Sharanya be able to rescue Vyom before its too late?

episodesList.title: The Wedding Date
episodesList.summary: The clairvoyant meets Sharanya and asks her to come with her. Sharanya does not believe her and decides to meet Vyom. Rajan sees Sharanya and Vyom together and is pleased but upon seeing the clairvoyant, he deices to stop her.

episodesList.title: The Hidden Truth
episodesList.summary: Rajan decides to punish the clairvoyant for coming in the way of Vyom and Sharanya. Meanwhile, Vyom calls upon Shiv. Enraged, Shiv enters Vyom’s body. Then, the clairvoyant, who has survived and has taken a new disguise decides to find out the truth about Rajan.

episodesList.title: The Secret
episodesList.summary: Sharanya is informed by Vyom’s mother that the engagement ring is lost. She is blamed for the loss but surprisingly Vyom reveals that he has the ring. Meanwhile, the clairvoyant is searching for any clues that will expose Rajan’s secret. What happens next,

episodesList.title: Trust Shattered
episodesList.summary: Vyom forces himself onto Sharanya. When the family members knock on the door, Sharanya manages to free herself. Vyom has no memory of the event and Sharanya does not inform her family members about it. While she is asleep, Shiv comes close to Sharanya. Will she find out that Vyom is innocent?

episodesList.title: Vyom is Missing
episodesList.summary: Before the engagement ceremony, Sharanya wants to speak with Vyom. She is haunted by the incident that occurred last night and wants to clarify with Vyom. The family members panic when they fail to find Vyom. Where is Vyom?

episodesList.title: Vyom Attempt Suicide
episodesList.summary: Sharanya is on the terrace and watches Vyom walking on the railing. She screams and runs towards him and tells him to forgive her and forget everything and come down. Vyom keeps on walking on the railing and then suddenly comes down. He doesn't seem like himself as if he is under someone else's influence or control. He holds Sharanya from her next and throws and locks her in the water tank

episodesList.title: Haunted Vyom
episodesList.summary: The spirit leaves Vyom's body and he comes back to his senses. He helps to get Sharanya out if the water tank but doesn't remember what happened a few moments ago. Sharanya is scared and takes Vyom with him and runs. When everyone asks what's wrong and where she was going, she tells them everything. After a certain hesitation, they all believe her. She takes Vyom to a temple but the spirit again enters his body.

episodesList.title: Belief
episodesList.summary: Ranvir tells Sarika that he couldn’t fulfill the promise which he made to them that he will never let tears come in their eyes, and that’s why he wants to fulfill his other promise made to Kabir. He says it was his dream to marry Aanchal for Kabir and asks her to agree. Sarika says I understand your every move and says you are trying to convince me, but I will never be happy and says whenever she will see Aanchal, she will hold her responsible for his death. She says although you all have accepted this, she will find the treatment for this disease.

episodesList.title: In Search Of Truth
episodesList.summary: Sharanya's father tells her to stop worrying about him. He wipes the tears from his family members’ faces. He tells Sharanya she is his brave kid and assures her he won't let it let any problem be with her life.

episodesList.title: Letter
episodesList.summary: A flashback shows Bishts waiting eagerly for Sharanya as she was about to return after 2 long years. Doorbell rings. Bishts receive the letter along with a parcel. They are about to open the parcel when Mrs. Bisht gets a call about Sharanya’s accident. She drops the phone in shock. They leave the house right away. Flashback ends. Mr. Bisht reads the date on the letter – December. He reads it again. There is something which is bothering me. There is something which no one knows. I am in trouble and I need your help! He is shocked after reading it. It means all this happened in Kapali Hills Temple. He checks the parcel. It has a box. He panics seeing it.

episodesList.title: Predict Death
episodesList.summary: Freddy and Odhni are on their way. She tells him to drive fast. I have to reach there before the wedding happens. They almost miss hitting someone. Odhni looks in the mirror and realizes it was Sharanya’s father. She makes him stop the car. They try looking for him but are unable to find him. Freddy asks her if she was sure it was him. She nods. What was he doing here at this time? He should have been at the wedding! Who was he running from? Was that spirit following him? Shiv walks past her just then. Odhni feels his presence. She sees flashes of someone being stabbed. She looks at the sun. Sun is about to be helpless. It is going to be dark. Bad spirits will rule during this time!

episodesList.title: Mantra Enchant
episodesList.summary: Vyom and Sharanya stand in a circle of fire. Vyom's hands are tied by a chain. Many Aghoris are standing just outside the circle of fire. Sharanya says, "Vyom, you fought with God and the world for me! You fought with yourself every day so you could win my heart. How can you lose out to this spirit then? You cannot let anyone come between us! You will have to fight Vyom! You will have to win. We will have to win." Vyom is having trouble breathing.

episodesList.title: Grah-Pravesh
episodesList.summary: Chandni tries to do Vyom and Sharanya’s Grah-Pravesh but Rajan asks her if she hasn’t taken it too seriously that she will take Madhvi’s place. He pulls Madhvi out of a corner and tells her to welcome Sharanya with happiness with open arms. Chandni glares in their direction. Rajan gives the puja thali to Madhvi. Will the Grah-Pravesh be devastating for the family members?

episodesList.title: Sharanya Challenges Shiv
episodesList.summary: Vyom tells Sharanya that whatever bad to happen has happened. Now only good things will happen. They leave. Footsteps form out of vermilion spread on the floor. Mrs. Bisht and Aditya meet Bedi family. Sharanya asks about Mr. Bisht. Vyom suggests canceling the function to go look for Mr. Bisht. Mrs. Bisht denies. Chandni asks Vyom about the call he got. He shares that a landslide has happened. Mrs. Bisht tells Sharanya not to cancel the function. So many guests are here. If his father will come, he will end up scolding me only.

episodesList.title: Shiv's Secret
episodesList.summary: Mr. Bisht is dead and Ananya breaks down saying that she'll take her revenge and she'll find who was behind it and she'll destroy them. Shiv is present at the scene. Mrs. Bisht holds Ananya as the dead body of her father is taken away. Odhni is in the lockup and tries to think about the culprit who stabbed Mr. Bisht.

episodesList.title: Bedi Family's Secret
episodesList.summary: Sharanya gets to know the spirit’s name. Vyom and Sharanya try to find out the mystery behind the murder of Sharanya's father. Vyom tells her to rest and he will do everything in his power to find the killer and that he cannot fill the void of her father but he'll always be by her side no matter what.

episodesList.title: Odhni Jailed
episodesList.summary: Epi begins with Sharanya asking Vyom if he knows Shiv. He declines and switches on the lights. He turns to go but she points out that trust is between 2 people. Vyom recalls Madhvi’s words. She is drunk. She said something wrong earlier too. Sharanya shares that Freddy also took Shiv’s name. Vyom’s expression turns to anger.

episodesList.title: Rajan Warns Vidyut
episodesList.summary: Sharanya gets scared and goes to Vyom as room lights go off. Sharanya gets balm for him. He tells her that she is a blessing in his life who makes all his difficulties easier. That’s why it’s very important for him to have her in his life. Sharanya applies balm on Vyom’s hand. Sharanya has tears in her eyes and asks how he waited 2 years for her and did so much for her in those 2 years.

episodesList.title: Vidyut Dies
episodesList.summary: Sharanya comes to the godown as Vidyut call her and tell her about the letter. Lights turn on and Vidyut comes out as Sharanya walks into the godown. She refers him as uncle and he asks her not to call him that. There is not much age difference between them. Vidyut says he cannot control his feelings seeing a beautiful girl like her. He takes out the letter and says she had to come to him for that letter that has Shiv's secret. She tries to take it, but Vidyut tells that there is a price for everything.

episodesList.title: Rituals
episodesList.summary: Rajan asks everyone to leave as fire starts, but Sharanya still goes to find the letter. Shiv and Vyom both watch Sharanya going behind a letter. Vyom rushes and stops her, takes her and drags her out of the factory. Meanwhile, the factory explodes.

episodesList.title: haranyas Quest
episodesList.summary: In this episode, Sharanya continues on her quest to find out about Shiv’s past. She meets Madhvi, who knows about Shiv. When she inquires about Shiv, Madhvi remembers Shiv’s undying love for Sharanya. In order to get rid of Shiv from her life, Sharanya plans a move.

episodesList.title: Sharanyas Lays A Trap
episodesList.summary: Sharanya is determined to trap Shiv’s wandering spirit and free herself of his menacing presence. She devises a plot and with the help of Vyom she lets Shiv’s spirit into the trap. Vyom however is unaware of Sharanya’s plan and merely plays a part. Will Shiv’s spirit be captured?

episodesList.title: Sharanya Learns The Truth
episodesList.summary: Sharanya traps Shiv's ghost. She demands answers, but Shiv escapes and brutally injures Vyom. But Sharanya sees that that the ghost who has been after her is none other than Shiv. How will she handle this information? Find out.

episodesList.title: Sharanya is at a Temple
episodesList.summary: Sharanya is at a temple. She is in the process of asking the Devi for answers.

episodesList.title: Sharanya Goes To Kapali Hills
episodesList.summary: Sharanya says goodbye to Vyom. Who is in the hospital fighting for his life. Sharanya heads to Kapali Hills.

episodesList.title: Sharanya Sees Shiv
episodesList.summary: Sharanya tells Shiv that she isn't scared of him. She prays to the goddess. And while she does Shiv joins in as well. Sharanya becomes aware of his presence.

episodesList.title: Sharanya Remembers
episodesList.summary: Sharanya finds Shiv's body in the ice. She gets flashes of her memory back. She seems to remember who Shiv is.

episodesList.title: Sharanya Breaks Down
episodesList.summary: Sharanya remembers her past. She wants to be with Shiv once again. Shiv finally talks. He tells her that he has been trying to make her remember ever since she woke up from her coma.

episodesList.title: Shivs Death
episodesList.summary: Shiv tells Sharanya to remember how he died. He tells her that his death was no accident but was a murder. It is revealed that Vyom is not who seems.

episodesList.title: Vyom Confesses
episodesList.summary: Sharanya comes to know that Vyom had orchestrated Shiv's murder. Shiv and Vyom were friends. Shiv tells her that more than Vyom, it was his family that wanted him to get together with Sharanya.

episodesList.title: Sharanya Asks For Shiv's Help
episodesList.summary: Shiv tells Sharanya to leave Vyom's house, but she refuses. She wants to find out who killed Shiv. Sharanya asks Shiv for his help in finding out who killed him.

episodesList.title: Murderer's Identity
episodesList.summary: Sharanya breaks her fast but Vyom does not realize Shiv’s presence. She tries to find the clue that leads to the murderer: the murderer has a birth mark on his ankle. Will she finally unravel the identity of the murderer?

episodesList.title: Odhni Hears Freddy's Clip
episodesList.summary: Sharanya lifts the blanket in an attempt to check the mark on Vyom’s leg. Sound engineer fixes the audio and Mohini hears it. Odhni sets the table to find her answers by invoking someone’s spirit.

episodesList.title: Odhni Finds A Clue
episodesList.summary: Sharanya notices blood on Vyom's leg and gets worried. Odhni cry realizing that Freddy is no more. Sharanya decides to take Madhvi aunty's help to find the real culprit as she never wanted her to marry Vyom and was against it all along.

episodesList.title: Madhvi Slaps Sharanya
episodesList.summary: Sharanya continues asking Madhvi to speak up. Madhvi is about to say something when she remembers Rajan’s warning. Sharanya asks her again to which Madhvi replies that she isn’t hiding anything and tells to stop asking useless questions. Madhvi tells that she doesn’t have answers to her questions. Sharanya holds her hand while Madhvi ends up slapping her.

episodesList.title: The Car
episodesList.summary: Sharanya and Shiv spot a car. Sharanya remembers Shiv telling her about a similar car. Shiv confirms that it is the same car he ssaw before dying.

episodesList.title: The Secret of Kapali Hills
episodesList.summary: Sharanya informs Shiv about her suspicion that Madhavi was not injured in an accident but was intentionally harmed. Later, she gets a call from the clairvoyant who informs her that Freddy knows everything about the Kapali Hills.

episodesList.title: Vyom Is Going Insane
episodesList.summary: Vyom is going out of his mind. He goes on about how he loves Sharanya. But even if Sharanya gets in the way of his love, he will kill Sharanya too. Vyom finds Freddy on the street and he runs him over.

episodesList.title: Sharanya Is Confused
episodesList.summary: Sharanya doesn't understand why Vyom has brought Freddy home. Vyom wants to keep a close eye on him. That is why he brought him home.

episodesList.title: Vyom Is Suspicious
episodesList.summary: Vyom has his mother's room bugged. He has installed CCTV cameras installed. Vyom is spying on her. He sees her talking to somebody but he doesn't know who.

episodesList.title: The Broken Bangles
episodesList.summary: Vyom's father is suspicious. He questions Sharanya about her broken bangles. He is not satsfied with her answers. Vyom tells him to back off. Vyom's father gets angry.

episodesList.title: When Vyom Drinks
episodesList.summary: Shiv tells Sharanya to remember what Vyom does when he is happy. Sharanya remembers an incident when Vyom got drunk and caused her to collide with Shiv. Sharanya remembers that Vyom's weakness is liquor.

episodesList.title: Vyom Doubts Sharanya
episodesList.summary: Sharanya dances in the Bedi House in her inebriated state. Vyom starts to doubt her after seeing her weird behavior.

episodesList.title: Vyom Knows Everything
episodesList.summary: Its now clear to Vyom what he has been doubting about Sharanya all along. Vyom feels Shiv's presence but fails to believe it. Shiv is successful in finding the car. Rajan scolds Vyom for his lack of concern for Vidyut

episodesList.title: Vyom's Doubt
episodesList.summary: Sharanya is being spied upon by Vyom, as he believes she is trying to hide something from him. Vyom installs CCTV in the kitchen to keep track of Sharanya’s movements. Will Vyom find out Shiv’s presence?

episodesList.title: Shiv Gets Burned In Fire
episodesList.summary: Sharanya gets stuck in the fire as she searches for Shiv. She finds his body burning and is shocked.Vyom hears her shouting for Shiv and realizes his doubt on Sharanya was right all along.

episodesList.title: Vyom Figures Out Everything
episodesList.summary: Shiv gets burned in the fire and doesn't respond when Sharanya takes her name. She cries and screams for him but he doesn't answer. Vyom sees Sharanya taking Shiv's name and asking him to come back to him and figures out everything.

episodesList.title: Vyom's Truth
episodesList.summary: Sharanya's memories get triggered and she remembers the time when she spoiled Shiv's shirt with ink.

episodesList.title: Rati Is Disturbed
episodesList.summary: Vyom tells Rati everything as to how he killed Vidyut and has been behind everything that's been happening. Rati is disturbed after her encounter with Vyom. Vyom gives Rati an option. Either she confesses that she is the culprit behind everything or he'll be forced to hurt Avni.

episodesList.title: Sharanya's Memories
episodesList.summary: Madhvi informs Rajan that Vyom has killed his brother. Rajan is shocked to hear that Vyom has committed another murder. Meanwhile, Sharanya remembers her past. The time she spent with Shiv brings a smile on her face.

episodesList.title: Rajan Slaps Vyom
episodesList.summary: Sharanya and Shiv see the marks on Rati's wrist. They also hear her talking to Avni while patting her head that she won't let that devil hurt her.

episodesList.title: Vyom's Madness
episodesList.summary: As we saw in the last episode that the insanity that Vyom has, he has gotten it from Rajan. Rajan knows everything as to how Vyom has killed his brother and many others because of Sharanya and will continue to do so but still he supports him. Rati tries to show the video that she found in Vidyut's laptop to Sharanya but Vyom interrupts them.

episodesList.title: Vyom Takes Avni
episodesList.summary: Vyom decides to carry out his plans in Shiv's absence after he hears Sharanya saying that Shiv is never there during the sunrise and sunset. Vyom threatens Rati and takes Avni with him to teach her a lesson. Rajan regrets his decisions and apologizes to Madhvi. Madhvi goes after Vyom to save Avni.

episodesList.title: Avni In Danger
episodesList.summary: Vyom takes Avni with him when he sees Rati going out with her somewhere and threatens Rati that he will kill Avni. Rati tells this to Vyom's mother and she goes after him to save Avni. Vyom almost runs her over with his car when she stands in his way. Shiv saves the day.

episodesList.title: Shiv Saves Avni
episodesList.summary: Shiv saves Avi and returns to Sharanya to inform her about Avi. As Sharanya is about to leave Vyom arrives. Then, Sharanya arrives at the bridge and takes Avi home. Will Vyom’s secret be revealed?

episodesList.title: Sharanya's Suspicion
episodesList.summary: Sharanya informs Shiv that Vyom is behind Avni’s accident. She suspects that Rati and Avni are afraid about Vyom. During their conversation, Shiv and Sharanya reminisce about their past when they are just falling in love with each other.

episodesList.title: The Bracelet
episodesList.summary: Shiv and Sharanya come across Urni. Sharanya informs her about Shiv’s presence and Vyom’s hand behind Shiv’s murder. She shows Urni a bracelet, which can prove Vyom’s crime. But, then Sharanya receives a call and learns that Madhvi’s life is in danger.

episodesList.title: Madhvi's Act
episodesList.summary: Vyom and Madhvi plan to get Sharanya back home. Sharanya realises that Madhvi has been lying to her all along and is still trying to protect her son after everything. Vyom Asks Sharanya if she's trying to hide anything from him. Vyom even asks her if she brought back the ghost from Kapali HIlls.

episodesList.title: The Video
episodesList.summary: Vyom tries to get close to Sharanya which makes Shiv furious and he pushes Vyom and Sharanya gets out of there somehow. Shiv and Sharanya somehow find the video recording of a locker room and a man in woman's clothes open one of the lockers and takes something out of it.  Sharanya has a flashback while watching the video and realizes something.

episodesList.title: Vyom's Fool-Proof Plan
episodesList.summary: Sharanya is fed up with Vyom's fake love and concern and shouts at him for faking it. Vyom installs cameras everywhere in the house and watches Sharanya talking to Shiv. Shiv tells Sharanya that Vyom is always a step ahead and they have to be better than him to get the truth out. Sharanya decides to get the truth out of Vyom as soon as she can and plans a party for him.

episodesList.title: Sharanya Is Determined
episodesList.summary: Shiv recalls the day Sharanya proposed to him. He apologizes to Sharanya for having behaved rudely with her that day.  Vyom too walks down the memory lane and recalls the day he realized Shiv was between him and Sharanya. Will Sharanya get a confession out of Vyom?

episodesList.title: Now Is The Time
episodesList.summary: Sharanya is getting restless about the party as she believes that it's finally time to get the truth out of Vyom. Vyom gives Sharanya a dress to wear for the party but she burns it in front of Shiv. Shiv and Sharanya remember the time when they both acted in the play and Shiv confessed his love for her which makes Sharanya emotional.

episodesList.title: Vyom's Confession
episodesList.summary: Sharanya arranges a valentine's day party and invites everyone. She wants everyone to know his truth and gives him a perfect audience for his confession. Sharanya intimidates Vyom with a song telling their story and the scenario of Vyom killing Shiv, Ram Uncle and Vidyut. Finally Vyom confesses his crimes and Sharanya calls the police to arrest Vyom.

episodesList.title: The Game Changer
episodesList.summary: Sharanya gives Vyom the perfect audience to confess his crimes and so he did. Finally Vyom confessed killing Shiv, Ram uncle and Vidyut but the entire games changes and Vyom's mother confesses killing everyone. Vyom manipulates Madhvi to take the balme and also makes Freddy to lie to everyone.

episodesList.title: More Lies
episodesList.summary: Madhvi has taken the blame for Shiv, Vidyut and Ram uncle's murder to save Vyom. Rajan is furious at Vyom for making Madhvi take the blame. He slaps him and confronts him. Vyom promises him to bring back Madhvi in three days. Shiv leaves Sharanya and says that his work there is done now which leaves Sharanya heartbroken. Will Shiv ever come back? Will the truth be ever uncovered?

episodesList.title: Memories
episodesList.summary: Sharanya cries taking Shiv's name as she believes that he left her alone but he comes back and surprises her. Shiv takes Sharanya to the same place where they had their first valentine date. Shiv sings and they both dance and remember the good times but little do they know that Vyom was watching them and now knows that Shiv didn't leave. Rajan beats up Vyom and tells him to get his mother back in three days.

episodesList.title: Questions
episodesList.summary: Rajan beats up Vyom and tells him to get Madhvi back in three days or he'll kill the root of all these problems, Sharanya. Sharanya believes that what they did to Vyom was wrong and they should apologise to him but Shiv tells her to ask a few questions to Vyom. Vyom tells her more and more lies and she starts believing him.

episodesList.title: Another Chance
episodesList.summary: Sharanya is convinced that Vyom didn't have anything to do with Shiv's murder and he was just trying to save his mother and decides to give him another chance. But Shiv has some other plans.

episodesList.title: Rajan's Game Plan
episodesList.summary: Sharanya tries to make Vyom and Shiv friends again and decides to drink with both of them just like the old days but Shiv refuses and break the glass in Vyom's hand. Rajan calls the police and files the missing complaint of Saadhvi. Shiv makes Sharanya realise that Vyom is behind Saadhvi's disappearance. Rajan warns Vyom that if he doesn't get Madhvi out of the jail, he'll kill Sharanya.

episodesList.title: The Evidence
episodesList.summary: Madhvi informs the police officer that she is the murderer. But, the officer demands evidence. Rajan assures Madhvi that she does not have to face punishment for the crimes she did not commit. Later, Rajan informs Vyom that soon the police will find the culprit and Vyom will be arrested. Then, the police barge into Rajan’s house and search the premises.

episodesList.title: The Lake
episodesList.summary: Police interrogate Madhvi about Sadhvi Ji's whereabouts. Shiv tells Sharanya that Sadhvi Ji is dead and her body is in the lake where they saved Avni from. Rajan tells Madhvi that their biggest secret, Suvarna is held in the lake house near that lake and if police find out about it, they are all as good as dead.

episodesList.title: Sharanya Jumps In The Lake
episodesList.summary: Police reach the lake to find Sadhvi's body but couldn't find any but Sharanya jumps into the lake and Shiv helps her finding Sadhvi's body. Rajan gets worried about Dhananjay's body as he threw his body in the same lake several years ago. Will Sharanya find other secrets of Vyom's family in that lake?

episodesList.title: Shiv's Suspicion
episodesList.summary: Rajan meets Madhavi in the prison. Before meeting her, Rajan had created a ruckus at home. Shiv informs Sharanya that he suspects that Madhavi is innocent. Will Shiv uncover the truth about Madhavi?

episodesList.title: Vyom's Deception
episodesList.summary: Rajan gets a message from Vyom on his cell phone and learns that Shiv is around him. Shiv informs Sharanya that Vyom might have informed Rajan. Vyom manages to deceive Sharanya and she ends up believing him. Will Sharanya learn that Vyom is deceiving her?

episodesList.title: Shiv's Torture
episodesList.summary: Vyom makes Shiv and Sharanya remember their college days. Later when Sharanya falls asleep, Vyom goes to Odhni and starts torturing her. Shiv and Sharanya follow him and reach a strange place.

episodesList.title: Rajan Threatens Vyom
episodesList.summary: Odhni manipulates Sharanya to burn Shiv's body so that he can rest in peace otherwise he'll always remain a spirit and be in pain. Shiv asks Sharanya to visit the house near the lake as he always gets attracted to that house

episodesList.title: Rajan's Secret
episodesList.summary: Vyom listens to Sharanya’s conversation with Shiv. He learns that Sharanya is going to an isolated cabin. Vyom calls up Rajan and asks him about the secrets hidden inside the cabin. Sharanya and Shiv arrive at the cabin. Rajan too arrives there and tries to conceal the secret hidden inside the cabin. What secrets does the cabin hold?

episodesList.title: Shiv Finds Out Suvarna
episodesList.summary: Shiv and Sharanya visit the abandoned cabin near the lake and find Suvarna there tied to the chains. Rajan also reaches there and holds a gun to Sharanya's head. To everyone's Sharanya's surprise, Suvarna can actually see and talk to Shiv. Suvarna tells Shiv and Sharanya the truth about Rajan.

episodesList.title: Rajan Is Dead
episodesList.summary: Vyom is taken to the hospital after being shot by Rajan. Shiv learns the truth about Suvarna being his mother from Vyom. Rajan being taken in an ambulance dies after there is an explosion in the ambulance.

episodesList.title: Time To Go
episodesList.summary: Suvarna consoles Vyom after his father's death. Sharanya and Shiv apologise to Vyom for doubting him. Suvarna gives Vyom the papers regarding their properties which Rajan took from her and her husband. Vyom fakes torturing Freddy to manipulate Odhni to send Shiv to the afterlife so he can have Sharanya for himself. Shiv tells Suvarna that its time for him to go now.

episodesList.title: Rajan Returns
episodesList.summary: Shiv suffers from pain and Vyom calls Odni to check on Shiv. Odni informs Sharanya that Shiv has to leave to his world. But, Shiv decides to stay back. Meanwhile, Madhavi’s car comes to a screeching halt, and Madhavi discovers that Rajan is alive. How did Rajan plot his own death?

episodesList.title: Let Go
episodesList.summary: Shiv decides to move on to the afterlife and tells this to Suvarna. Suvarna asks Odhni what they need to do to make Shiv move on so Odhni tells them that they need to burn everything that belongs to Shiv including his dead body. Sharanya goes into shock as she doesn't know how to let Shiv go. Shiv tries to make her understand that its only right for him to move on.

episodesList.title: Lingering Doubts
episodesList.summary: After the final rites of Shiv and his final meet-up with Saranya, multiple incidents occur that evokes doubt in Saranya's mind against Vyom.

episodesList.title: A Shocking Realization
episodesList.summary: Sharanya follows the car ignoring her mother's request, to confirm her suspicion. After a long chase, she finally overtakes the car and the sight of the people inside shocks her to the core. What will happen next?.

episodesList.title: Shiv Is Back
episodesList.summary: Vyom's truth comes in front of Sharanya and she is devastated. She runs away from home into the woods where Vyom follows her. Sharanya finds a Kul Devi’s idol which his father was carrying before his death and a ring that Shiv gave her. WHat will happen next?

episodesList.title: Reunite In Death
episodesList.summary: Rajan threatens Sharanya to back off and give him the ring or he'll shoot Suvarna. This stops Shiv from killing Vyom as he puts him down. Sharanya is about to give Rajan the ring back, just then Suvarna pushes Sharanya and she dies after falling on the road. Shiv and Sharanya reunite in death but what now?

episodesList.title: The Leap
episodesList.summary: The show takes a leap of twenty-five years. Vyom's sister Shivani returns home after living abroad all his life and having no clue about Shiv, Vyom and Sharanya's story. She brings home her boyfriend whom she wants to marry and makes Rajan and Madhvi meet him. Rajan and Madhvi see him and are shocked.

episodesList.title: The Dark Memories
episodesList.summary: Rajan and Madhvi remember their dark past about Vyom, Shiv, and Sharanya. Madhvi believes that Sharanya has come back as Shivani to take her revenge. Shivani and Akash are going to be engaged in the same house as Vyom and Sharanya. But then Akash invites someone to the party which shocks Madhvi and Rajan.

episodesList.title: Past Revived
episodesList.summary: At the party, Madhvi and Rajan are baffled seeing Krish, who bears an uncanny resemblance with Shiv. Rajan tries to console Madhvi by informing that it is merely a coincidence that Krish resembles Shiv. Has Shiv indeed returned or is it merely a coincidence?

episodesList.title: Suvarna Meets Krish
episodesList.summary: Krish feels something strange in Shivani's house so he decides to take a walk around the house. He notices some people beating up Suvarna and goes to rescue her. Suvarna sees Krish and can't believe what she is seeing. What will happen now? Will Suvarna tell everything to Krish?

episodesList.title: Secrets of the Past
episodesList.summary: Krish is intrigued after meeting Shiv’s mother. He tries to remember but the memories are too feeble. Later, Krish during the process of painting Shivani ends up painting Sharanya. Will the secrets of the past finally come to the fore?

episodesList.title: Shooting
episodesList.summary: Krish wonders whose painting he drew while watching Shivani and is intrigued by the girl in the painting. Shivani is woken up by someone's touch but when she wakes up all she sees is a shadow. The first day of shooting starts and Akash, Shivani, and Krish reach there for the opening ceremony but a surprise waits for them at the shooting site.

episodesList.title: Sharanya Returns
episodesList.summary: Krish is shooting an action sequence. Seeing large crowd he decides to perform his own stunts. Shooting the entire event of a video camera is a woman who resembles Sharanya. Who is this woman and why is she shooting Krish?

episodesList.title: Radhika's Arrival
episodesList.summary: Radhika, who resembles Sharanya, is caught filming Krish’s action sequence. Shivani recognizes Radhika and reveals that she is her friend. How will Radhika and Krish’s life collide?

episodesList.title: When Paranoia Takes Over
episodesList.summary: Krish believes that he has some kind of a unique connection with Radhika as he painted her portrait even before he met her. Krish also feels that Rajan and Madhvi are not as innocent as they seem and are hiding some dark secrets. Radhika also feels a strange connection to Krish and has some flashbacks while applying an ointment on Krish's back.

episodesList.title: The Ghosts From The Past
episodesList.summary: Radhika feels a weird vibe while staying at Rajan's house. She feels a unique connection with Krish and is lost of words when confronted about it by Shivani. Krish refuses to come out of his room for the shoot after he got a little injury so Shivani convinces Radhika to get his out of the room. Krish somehow remembers Sharanya's name.

episodesList.title: The Hidden Door
episodesList.summary: Akash makes Shivani upset after screaming at her and in the process of talking to her, they find a secret passage between the walls of the house. Radhika is told to convince Krish for the shoot but things go sideways when Krish abuses her too.

episodesList.title: The Secret
episodesList.summary: The door that wasn’t supposed to be unlocked is opened by Shivani and Akash, who venture inside the secret chamber. Rajan and Madhvi find that Shivani has gone inside the chamber and follow her. Shivani and Akash are stopped by Rajan. Will the secrets the lie on the other side of the door be unraveled?

episodesList.title: The Haunted
episodesList.summary: Shivani and Akash enter the hidden door and are caught by Madhvi and Rajan. While they are being talked to by Rajan, Krish enters the hidden door and finds Suvarna inside the door but gets unconscious after someone hits his head with a kane. Will Krish be able to find the truth?

episodesList.title: Krish Seeks Radhika's Help
episodesList.summary: Krish addresses Radhika as "Sharanya" by mistake. Rajan and Madhvi ask Akash and Shivani to shut down the movie project and throw the idea of getting married out of the window. Krish seeks Radhika's help to get to the truth behind the weird things happening with him. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Won't Let You Go
episodesList.summary: Radhika decides to leave the house and asks Akash to drop her to the airport but Krish and Shivani make her stay. Suvarna tries to escape while Rajan and Madhvi are locked in their room. Krish sees Suvarna and follows her to the basement. Will Krish meet Suvarna again? Will Rajan and Madhvi's truth ever come out?

episodesList.title: The Past
episodesList.summary: Krish glimpses the past memories but doesn't connect the dots. He feels a strange connection with Radhika. Meanwhile, Shivani informs Akash that they should leave the house. Then, Madhvi and Rajan enter the secret chamber in which they have confined Shiv’s mother. Will Akash find out the presence of Shiv’s presence?

episodesList.title: Flashbacks
episodesList.summary: Krish and Radhika come close to each other and Radhika wonder why someone like her is getting attracted towards someone like him.  Rajan And Madhvi decide to leave Suvarna at a place from where she wouldn't be able to come back. Akash gets flashbacks of Kapaali Hills after Radhika tells him about a beautiful temple there.

episodesList.title: The Secret Door
episodesList.summary: Radhika sees Madhvi and Rajan dragging Suvarna from the basement to a car and follows them until someone holds her from behind and calls her Sharanya. Shivani catches Radhika and Akash in the kitchen in the middle of the night and gets furious. Radhika and Krish decide to find out the truth once and for all.

episodesList.title: A Game of Deceit
episodesList.summary: Radhika is very sure someone is trapped inside the house and she is making a compelling accusation against Rajan and Madhavi. As Radhika speaks to Akash about this Shivani overhears and she is furious. As off this happens someone is seen to be peaking from the walls.

episodesList.title: The Tangled Truth
episodesList.summary: Madhavi tells Shivani that she disagrees of her relationship with Akash and that Madhavi finds Shivani extremely docile when she is with Akash. Krish and Radhika come together to solve the mystery behind who,  Radhika had seen the other night. Midst of it all, someone watches over Krish and Radhika.

episodesList.title: Accusations
episodesList.summary: Krish and Radhika decide to uncover the truth that Madhvi and Rajan have been trying so hard to hide. Radhika asks Shivani's forgiveness after Radhika accused her parents of hiding something. Akash warns Krish to stay away from their family matters or he'll face the consequences.

episodesList.title: Someone's Watching
episodesList.summary: Krish shares with Akash that he feels like there's always someone watching them or listening to them in this house but Radhika interrupts him before he speaks too much as she doesn't trust Akash. Shivani tells Akash to maintain a proper distance with Radhika.

episodesList.title: Friendship Or Love
episodesList.summary: Akash and Krish fight for Radhika’s attention and some mean comments are echanged between them. Radhika say something she can’t take back. Rajan and Madhavi still doubt Akash as they think Shivani’s safety might be compromised.

episodesList.title: Akash's Accident
episodesList.summary: Akash falls to the ground and suffers a head injury. After treatment, Akash regains consciousness. When Shivani insists that they leave the house, Akash, Radhika, and Krish disagree. Then, Akash meets Radhika and Krish and shares them the last minute details before his fall.

episodesList.title: Nightmares
episodesList.summary: Radhika, Akash, and Krish discuss the strange things happening in Bedi house and Radhika tells them that they need to stick together in order to get to the truth. Shivani is in trauma after someone grabs her arm from the window in her room.

episodesList.title: Relationships Are At Stake
episodesList.summary: Shivani overhears Akash talking about his closeness with Radhika. Shivani’s doubts about Akash trying to cheat on her comes true. Radhika see a refelction on the bathroom mirror. Krish dreams about a past life. Akash and Shivani fights over their relationship.

episodesList.title: The Photograph
episodesList.summary: Shivani is furious after she finds out an old photograph of Sharanya and Vyom's marriage and mistakes them for Radhika and Akash but when she shows the photograph to Akash and confronts him, the picture goes blank. Krish shows Radhika the painting he made of her even before meeting her.

episodesList.title: Past Lives Matter
episodesList.summary: Radhika and Krish analyze the events that have been happening to them since they came to Bedi House and come to the conclusion that they were somehow related to each other in their past lives. Shivani and Akash decide to get married by the night itself which confuses Krish so he tells Radhika not to trust Akash anymore.

episodesList.title: Mask Off
episodesList.summary: Krish and Radhika starts doubting Akash’s  intentions, they are convinced that something is wrong with him. Akash takes off his mask in front of Shivani to reveal his true identity. Krish and Radhika find a file, which links industrialist Dhananjay to Mrs. Bedi. Someone is locked inside the house.

episodesList.title: The Reincarnation
episodesList.summary: Akash tell Shivani the truth about their past lives, Shivani is at shock. Krish confides in Radhika that he feels that there is some sort of a past connection. The truth is unfolded and no one knows hoe to handle it.

episodesList.title: The Only Truth That Matters
episodesList.summary: Akash tells Shivani how Mister and Misses Bedi used the power of black magic to bring her back to life again, and how Akash has hidden his true identity just to make Shivani fall in love with him. Radhika and Krish knows something is wrong, but they can’t put their fingers to it!

episodesList.title: Shivani Is No More
episodesList.summary: Krish and Radhika console each other about the circumstances they are going through. Akash injects himself with something. A new guy shows up and slits Shivani’s throat. Akash tries to fake a Shivani’s last words in a letter.

episodesList.title: Compromise
episodesList.summary: Vyom tells Madhavi and Ranjan about Shivani’s death and why he had done what he did. Radhika reveals to Krish that Shivani was not up for her wedding with Akash. Things take a nasty turn when Vyom reveals the whole truth.

episodesList.title: The Undead
episodesList.summary: Krish and Radhika wants to look for Shivani. Akash threats Mr and Mrs Bedi, they are at his gunpoint. Akash convinces Radhika to re-enact the past life character for his movie.

episodesList.title: 25 Years
episodesList.summary: Vyom reveals to Radhika that he has been waiting twenty five years for Shivani to be his. Radhika asks Krish to have faith on him and to be by her side. There is someone in the house and he gets a hold of Radhika, calls her out by Sharanya. Radhikaa is shocked to the bones before she goes unconscious.

episodesList.title: Lost Hopes
episodesList.summary: Radhika is convinced someone grabbed her, but Akash tries to manipulate her into thinking she got unconscious. Krish believes in Radhika and goes to look out for whoever grabbed her.

episodesList.title: Heart Break
episodesList.summary: Akash aka Vyom sets a trap to kill Krish but things turn nasty when his plans fail and he gets stabbed instead. Shivani and Krish take him to the hospital. Shivani gets a vision from the past. Krish proposes his love for Shivani just to get a cold rejection.

episodesList.title: Past Lives
episodesList.summary: Radhika gets a recollection of her past life, who she was and who she loved. She reconnects with Akash. Back at home, Krish is going crazy to admit that fact that Shivani has moved on.

episodesList.title: The 52-Year-Old Man
episodesList.summary: Vyom has somehow convinced Radhika that they are meant to be together, but what she doesn’t know that Vyom is actually a 52 year old man. Radhika finds Mr. and Mrs. Bedi locked inside the house.

episodesList.title: Krish Is Stabbed
episodesList.summary: Vyom aka Akash targets Krish and stabs him. Radhika is shocked and scared. Mr. and Mrs. Bedi revels the truth to Radhika. Vyom stoops a new low.

episodesList.title: The End
episodesList.summary: Radhika aka Sharanya is forced to choose between Mr. & Mrs. Bedi or Krish aka Shiv. Krish and Radhika swiftly turn the tables and put Vyom to his knees. Watch how it all ends.
