plotHtml:
In a fatal accident, Sharanya ends up in a coma. After 2 years, When she wakes up, she has no memory of the last 3 years. Vyom introduced himself to be her boyfriend. After strange incidents spontaneously threaten Vyom's life caused by a spirit, Sharanya decides to marry Vyom to save his life angering the spirit. As they get married, the spirit kills Sharanya's father. The spirit attacks and injures Vyom again and again, and Sharanya goes to Kapali Hills to find out how she can protect Vyom. There she discovers Shiv’s (the spirit) dead body.
Sharanya tries to prove Vyom's crimes, his mother Madhvi takes the blame and arrested. Vyom's father Rajan Bedi wants his wife released so he fake his death and put the blame on him thus procuring Madhvi's release.
Vyom called Odhni to get rid of Shiv's spirit and, on her advice, Shiv's mother Swarna to get Sharanya to perform Shiv's last rites and burn all his belongings. Sharanya sees Rajan and Madhvi together and confronts Vyom. Vyom is forced to admit his crime - the murder of Shiv's father (to protect his own parents).
Sharanya tells him that she could never love him and prepares to leave but Rajan told Sharanya to give him Shiv's ring so he can get rid of Shiv's spirit for good. But before she can remove it, Swarna pushes her off a cliff to her death.
About to kill Swarna, a distraught Vyom instead kills himself.
tagline: In a fatal accident, Sharanya ends up in a coma.

title: Ek Aastha Aisi Bhee
summary: Ek Aastha Aisi Bhee is an Indian Hindi television drama, produced by Shoonya Square Productions. The series starred Tina Philip and Kanwar Dhillon. It premiered on 3 April 2017 on StarPlus and aired from Monday through Saturday during the Star Plus Dopahar (afternoon) programming block. The series ended on 30 September 2017 with the discontinuation of the Star Plus Dopahar block.
plot: The series revolves around Aastha, an atheist girl from Manali, who gets married into a very religious family in Kolkata and tries to save the family from Guru Maa's ploys. Aastha's and Shiv's love is meant to be. Radhika, Shiv's ex-girlfriend comes and destroys their love by creating misunderstandings between them. Shiv wants Aastha to stop his marriage with Radhika. But Aastha thinks that if Shiv loves her he will not marry Radhika. Shiv and Aastha love each other a lot but are unable to tell each other. Radhika and Gurumas plan fails when Astha exposes Radhika through the use of a recorder. During their engagement, Astha uses technology to show how Radhika conspired against the whole family to obtain her interest. After Radhika is exposed, gurumaa says that she wants to do 'aarti' before she leaves the household to which the members retaliate. But, on Asthas convincing, the family members agree. Gurumaa gives prashad which contains sleeping pills. In the parallel scene, Radhika comes in Asthas room and holds her up against the wall with a knife. Arguments continue between Lakshmi, Gurumaa and others. Eventually, Shiv rescues Astha under the pretext of marrying Radhika. The show ends on a happy note that a person's character cannot be judged based on their religious views. An atheist person can be a good human and a religious person can be a bad human.

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text:
Initially titled as Nastik while in pre-production, the title Ek Aastha Aisi Bhee was finalized then.
This was one of the four dramas which was launched on 3 April 2017 during afternoon band of Star Plus Dopahar Block, reviving Star Plus' afternoon new programming after years.
In May 2017, while the leads Tina Philip and Kanwar Dhillon were shooting for a sequence in a lake of Film City, Philip drowned while Dhillon saved her.
A fire broke out on 9 August 2017 which destroyed parts of the sets, but no one was hurt. The series will be featured in Starlife as Prayers of love.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text: Tina Philip and Kanwar Dhillon were cast as the leads. Besides Sharanpreet Kaur, Manasi Salvi, Pallavi Rao, Anita Kulkarni, Palak Purswani, Lilly Patel, Supriya Sarna, Vivek Mushran, Abhinav Kapoor, Hemant Choudhary, Manisha Dave, Mayank Sharma, Samiksha Sud, Nikhil Sharma, Vaani Sharma and Ambika Soni were cast then.

articleSections.title: Filming
articleSections.text: Although set in Kolkata, the series is filmed at the sets created in Mumbai at Film City, Goregaon. Some earlier episodes were shot in Kolkata and Manali.

articleSections.title: Cancellation
articleSections.text: With the serials in the afternoon block not being able to garner the expected numbers in its ratings, the channel shut the show on September 30, 2017.

title: Ek Vivah Aisa Bhi
summary: Ek Vivah Aisa Bhi is an Indian Hindi romance television series, which premiered on 6 February 2017 on &TV. The series is produced by The House of Originals of Nivedita Basu. The show was replaced by Half Marriage after the last episode aired on 22 September 2017.
plot:
The story revolves around the young widow Suman. Suman is a caring mother, a responsible daughter-in-law and a loving sister-in-law. She balances between the household chores and her work in a local parlour every day to keep her family financially stable. She then joins a university to pursue an MBA on her mother-in-law's insistence. There she meets the carefree Ranveer Mittal. Though they dislike each other initially, Ranveer later falls for Suman. Meanwhile, Antara's and Sanjana's (Suman's sister in laws) marriage gets fixed to the two brothers of Ranveer. Suman's mother-in-law accepts Ranveer's alliance to secure the future of her daughters. Suman, initially hesitant, later accepts Ranveer. Suman and Ranveer get married with Suman's son Veer tying the "gat-bandhan".
There is a change in the behavior of Ranveer Mittal who becomes arrogant and refuses to accept Veer. Veer is thus kept back at his paternal home with his grandmother. It is later revealed that Suman's ex-husband, Ravi Parmar, who was assumed dead, is actually alive. Suman and Veer are both forced to move in with him.
Ravi begins to physically abuse Suman. Ranveer arrives in time and saves Suman. Suman, Veer and Ranveer reconcile.
In the last scene it is shown that the whole family, including the pregnant daughters-in-laws( Suman, Sanjana and Antara), gather for a family photo.

title: Ek Shringaar – Swabhiman
summary: Ek Shringaar — Swabhimaan (transl. Self-Respect – An Adornment) commonly abbreviated as Swabhimaan is an Indian television series. It was aired on Colors TV from 19 December 2016 to 29 September 2017. The show revolves around two sisters Meghna (Sangeeta Chauhan), Naina (Ankitta Sharma) and their mother Sharda (Prachi Shah) who has raised her daughters to be independent and self-sufficient. It replaced the show Swaragini.  and was replaced by Show Laado – Veerpur Ki Mardani.
plot:
Meghna and Naina are the beloved daughters of Sharda, a school teacher and single mother. After they graduate, they move to their uncle Vishnu's house with Sharda. Meghna falls in love with Kunal, the elder son of rich businessman Nandkishore whom she met in college days. Nandkishore rebuffs Sharda's proposal and humiliates her. But later, a royal marriage is fixed. Naina constantly bickers with kunal's younger brother Karan, who has health issues.
On the wedding day, Vishnu's wife Asha enrages Nandkishore who lays down condition that Meghna and Naina marry Kunal and Karan. Both couples marry, but Meghna vows to teach Nandkishore a lesson. His wife Nirmala lives under his domination. In reality her friend Sandhya and the governess of the Chauhans household, is Kunal's real mother. Naina befriends and helps the shy Karan overcome his hesitations. Vishnu's son Vishal falls in love with and marries Nandkishore's daughter Khyati.
After many turns of events, Naina and Karan fall in love and plan to get remarried. However it is revealed that Kunal is Sandhya's and not the real blood of Chauhan family, which leads to Nandkishore laying down an ultimatum for Kunal. Divorce Meghna and marry Saawri or leave the house. Kunal chooses his wife. After the departure of Kunal and Meghna, Naina is given all the responsibilities of the house. Soon all the women in the household depart from the mansion however Nandkishore soon realizes his mistakes and brings everyone together and begins treating everyone with love and respect. They have a family reunion.

plotHtml:
Meghna and Naina are the beloved daughters of Sharda, a school teacher and single mother. After they graduate, they move to their uncle Vishnu's house with Sharda. Meghna falls in love with Kunal, the elder son of rich businessman Nandkishore whom she met in college days. Nandkishore rebuffs Sharda's proposal and humiliates her. But later, a royal marriage is fixed. Naina constantly bickers with kunal's younger brother Karan, who has health issues.
On the wedding day, Vishnu's wife Asha enrages Nandkishore who lays down condition that Meghna and Naina marry Kunal and Karan. Both couples marry, but Meghna vows to teach Nandkishore a lesson. His wife Nirmala lives under his domination. In reality her friend Sandhya and the governess of the Chauhans household, is Kunal's real mother. Naina befriends and helps the shy Karan overcome his hesitations. Vishnu's son Vishal falls in love with and marries Nandkishore's daughter Khyati.
After many turns of events, Naina and Karan fall in love and plan to get remarried. However it is revealed that Kunal is Sandhya's and not the real blood of Chauhan family, which leads to Nandkishore laying down an ultimatum for Kunal. Divorce Meghna and marry Saawri or leave the house. Kunal chooses his wife. After the departure of Kunal and Meghna, Naina is given all the responsibilities of the house. Soon all the women in the household depart from the mansion however Nandkishore soon realizes his mistakes and brings everyone together and begins treating everyone with love and respect. They have a family reunion.
tagline: Meghna and Naina are the beloved daughters of Sharda, a school teacher and single mother.

title: Ek Rishta Saajhedari Ka
summary: Ek Rishta Saajhedari Ka (transl. A relationship of partnership) is an Indian drama television series which aired from 8 August 2016 to 31 March 2017 on Sony TV. Produced by Kavita Barjatya Productions of Kavita K. Barjatya, it starred Kinshuk Vaidya and Shivya Pathania as Aryan Sethia and Sanchi Mittal.
plot:
The show is set in the city of Jaipur in India. The Sethiya family has a son called Aryan and the Mithal family has a daughter called Saanchi. The families are given each other's reference and a meeting is arranged for Aryan and Saanchi. At first they hate each other but eventually get along and slowly fall in love.
Saanchi and Aryan begin seeing each other but their marriage alliance runs into trouble when the Sethiyas, on the verge of bankruptcy, decide to call off the wedding. The Mithals come to their rescue and thus the wedding takes place bringing both families close to each other in the process.
The rest of the series follows how Saanchi and Aryan decide to make their marriage an equal partnership and both try to rescue their families and family members from trouble. In a plot twist, Saanchi is forced to fake her death when much Aryan's family turns against her due to misunderstandings created by Nikita who is obsessed with Aryan. She returns in a new avatar and goes by the name, Malvika Seghal to expose Nikita along with the help of Aryan and Nilima. Nikita is finally exposed after a long time. The series ended on a positive note with all misunderstandings cleared and Saanchi giving birth to her and Aryan's first child.

title: Ei Chheleta Bhelbheleta
summary: Ei Chheleta Bhelbheleta (transl. This boy is fidgety) a Bengali television Drama Series that premiered on 28 March 2016 to 23 July 2017 and aired on Zee Bangla. The show was produced by Magic Moments Motion Pictures, it starred Prapti Chatterjee and Somraj Maity in lead roles, Nabanita Malakar, Sabitri Chatterjee, Anusuya Majumdar, Shankar Chakraborty and Bharat Kaul in supporting roles. The show got replaced by a show Karunamoyee Rani Rashmoni.
plot:
The show's unique name has been taken from common Bengali childhood rhyme. It truly captures the free-spirited love and chemistry between the protagonists - Abir and Shaluk. Life takes a turn when introvert city-bred boy 'Abir' meets the vivacious village girl 'Shaluk'. Their unusual friendship clicks in an instant and soon a sweet innocent chemistry develops between the two. Soon they realize their feelings towards each other. Thus, starts the story of their 'first love'. 'Eii Chhele Ta Bhelbhele Ta' is a tale of love, which follows the protagonists through myriad of situations and sees them unite against all odds. The story showcases a pure love story between two teenagers and how their love matures over time and rises above the different obstacles of life.
;Two years leap Two years later, Aishwarya is jailed and then after some days Shaluk becomes pregnant. There is happiness back In Shaluk's family. Later, Aishwarya makes a comeback as a new avatar of Shoroshoti to ruin Shaluk's happiness. She then tries to kill Shaluk. Later Shaluk is hospitalized and gives birth to a baby boy and Aishwarya's true colors are revealed in front of everyone.

title: Ek Duje Ke Vaaste
summary:
Ek Duje Ke Vaaste (transl. For the sake of each other) is an Indian Hindi-language romantic television series which aired on Sony TV from 29 February 2016 to 7 October 2016.
The female and male protagonists were played by Nikita Dutta and Namik Paul, respectively. The plot revolves around two childhood friends and follows their struggles to unite as lovers once they grow up. The series title track was composed by the duo Sachin–Jigar and sung by Jubin Nautiyal.
The show was dubbed into Tamil as Nee Varuvai Ena (English: I'm Waiting for You) in 2017 and aired on Polimer TV. The production is followed by a rebooted sequel, Ek Duje Ke Vaaste 2, where Shravan and Suman are recharacterized as teenagers attending school, with a military background.
plot:
Suman comes from a close-knit family and has been brought up by her grandfather as a strong, independent, and self-respecting girl after her parents died in an accident. Shravan is a Malhotra, an elite family of two brothers—Ramnath and Lala Ji, and their wives and sons—Shravan, Varun, and Pushkar. Suman's grandfather was a mentor to Shravan's father, Ramnath, and the two share a strong bond.
Growing up together, Shravan and Suman are separated when Shravan leaves for London to practise law after his parents, Nirmala and Ramnath, separate. He returns ten years later, and Suman discovers he has changed. She apologises to him for not being there for him, but he rejects her. At a school reunion, he insults Suman, after which they part ways until Suman's house is in danger of being sold. Shravan fights the court case and wins, and the two rekindle their friendship. Suman tries to reunite Shravan with his mother, but he believes his father's side of the story. A possessive Ramnath becomes upset with Suman and successfully drives a wedge between Shravan and her.
Suman's cousin Preeti falls in love with Pushkar, and they are able to convince their reluctant families to accept the union. Suman's grandfather suffers a heart attack and makes Suman promise him that she will marry Aditya, a family friend. Aditya, Shravan's foster brother who was brought up by Shravan's mother, becomes suspicious of Suman and Shravan's relationship after being incited by Shravan's aunt Kamini.
Following an instance of Aditya misbehaving with Suman, their wedding is called off. Sensing Suman's grandfather's condition, Shravan marries Suman. Over time, Ramnath realises how his lies have made Shravan a misogynist who mistreats the women in his life. Guilt-ridden, he comes clean to Shravan, who asks Suman for forgiveness. The two happily confess their love for each other and unite.

episodesList.title: Suman's Visa to USA
episodesList.summary: Suman is a young and beautiful girl who runs a tiffin service centre in Delhi. She is considered to a strict entrepreneur and her associates fear her. But she is totally opposite to that, who is very kind hearted and a super cool girl.

episodesList.title: Suman and Shravan's Friendship
episodesList.summary: Suman is very excited after knowing about her childhood friend Shravan, who was returning back to India after 10 years. She was looking for an excuse to visit his house and to relive those old memories.

episodesList.title: Welcome Party for Shravan
episodesList.summary: Everyone was waiting impatiently for Shravan to return back from London and there was a grand welcome party hosted for Shravan. However, to make the party a memorable one, everyone's comment was recorded.

episodesList.title: Suman's Childhood Memories
episodesList.summary: Suman was very excited to meet her childhood friend Shravan, and for this she has come rushing down to his house. However, she was feeling little nervous about the whole thing. But it was then, she heard Shravan speaking to his friend.

episodesList.title: Atithi Devo Bhava
episodesList.summary: Shravan is invited for a lunch together at Suman's house. But it was then, her aunt suddenly realized about the important visa formalities which are required to be completed. Suman was left alone at the house waiting for Shravan.

episodesList.title: Shatranj Ki Adhuri Baazi
episodesList.summary: Shravan was invited for a lunch together at Suman's house. However, Shravan, who has come to India after 10 long years, was feeling nostalgic after entering Suman's house.

episodesList.title: Suman's Memories of Schooldays
episodesList.summary: Shravan has said to Suman that he has moved on in his life and he doesn't remember the incident which has happened 10 years back. However, Suman feels very bad about it.

episodesList.title: London Return Waiting for Suman
episodesList.summary: Sharvan was playing Chess with Suman's grandfather in her house and both were having a candid discussion together. However, Suman knew very well that Shravan was waiting for her in her house, and she purposely tried to avoid him by reaching late.

episodesList.title: Shravan's Decision
episodesList.summary: Sharvan had an important engagement in the evening and hence he had to leave the Mata's puja in the middle. However; Vandy, Urvashi, and others, were waiting for Shravan to arrive, but as usual he has again got late. Want to know what happened next?

episodesList.title: Plans for Reunion Party
episodesList.summary: Suman was worried that she has started thinking too much about Shravan and thought that she should stop herself from doing this. However, later, in the episode, we will get to know that Suman has received an invitation.

episodesList.title: Sumo's Dress From Past
episodesList.summary: Sumo is getting ready for the special day, her dress brings some memories from the past which starts cajoling her. She is getting ready with a smile on her face and to start the best day of her life.

episodesList.title: Suman Returned Her Gift
episodesList.summary: Shravan has gifted Suman a mind-blowing dress but her ego came in between and she started thinking that Shravan just wants to impress her. However, she did open the gift in his absence.

episodesList.title: Shravan Convinces Sumo for Party
episodesList.summary: Suman was calculating her monthly budget for the month and she realized that she needs to control the monthly expenses. However, later in the episode, we will come to know that Suman has advised her uncle and aunty.

episodesList.title: Shravan Cares for Suman
episodesList.summary: Kamini and Vandy have devised a unique plan to get money from Mr. Malhotra. They are pretending to sell their precious jewellery in the market, in order to get money from it.

episodesList.title: Reunion Party
episodesList.summary: Suman is very excited for her school reunion party and for this, she has worn the fabulous dress gifted by her childhood friend, Shravan. However, Suman has reached the party venue and she is waiting impatiently for Shravan to arrive.

episodesList.title: Suman Realizes Her Mistake
episodesList.summary: Sharvan has insulted Suman before everyone in the reunion party, he has made her feel guilty for whatever she has done during their school days. However, the incident has taken her back into the flashback.

episodesList.title: Manju Scolds Suman
episodesList.summary: Babloo and Manju have missed their flight to the USA and they are blaming Suman for it. Manju is very angry with Suman, as she has promised to drop them to the airport but she arrived late!

episodesList.title: Shravan's Concern for Suman
episodesList.summary: Shravan seems to be tensed about whatever he has done with Suman. However, Vandy and others, are planning to initiate talks about Urvashi and Shravan's marriage, but prior to that, they wanted to know about Urvashi's chemistry with Shravan.

episodesList.title: Shravan Helps Suman
episodesList.summary: Suman is trying hard to collect her money which is due to her business associates. However, she is upset with Shravan for his rude and insulting behaviour during the reunion party. And, on the other hand, Shravan is repeatedly trying to meet her to discuss this.

episodesList.title: Happy Holi
episodesList.summary: In this episode, we will get to know that a Holi party is organized in Mr. Ramnath's house and every one, along with Suman's family, is invited to the party.

episodesList.title: Holi at Ramnath's House
episodesList.summary: Urvashi is very excited to get a chance to play Holi with Shravan. Everyone is playing Holi at Mr. Ramnath's house with full gusto, meanwhile, a dance face off commences between Urvashi and Suman. Who will win this face off? Watch the episode to find out!

episodesList.title: Shravan's Vision for His Future
episodesList.summary: Much to Urvashi's disappointment, Shravan expresses his eagerness to move in a treehouse instead of a penthouse, he also affirms that he would like to fight cases for the people who can't afford pricey lawyers. Suman and Shravan cross paths again and get into an argument.

episodesList.title: Khosla Ki Chaal
episodesList.summary: Suman's grandfather gives her a file to submit urgently to Ramnath, for a case hearing. Meanwhile, Ramnath, gets to know that Shravan is planning to return back to London, he gets disappointed with Shravan and scolds him.

episodesList.title: Suman's House Mortgaged by Her Mother
episodesList.summary: In this episode, moneylender, Dhirendra, demands his money back from Suman's family and shows the agreement papers, in which Suman's mother had mortgaged their house for a loan. Now, he has given a time period of 24 hours to return the money. What will Suman's family do now?

episodesList.title: Suman in Trouble
episodesList.summary: Suman tries seeking help from Shravan to save her house. Shravan who's counted her to be a selfish girl, refuses to help her and stays firm on his decision to go back to London. Khosla arrives at Suman's house the next morning for the money. What will the family do now?

episodesList.title: Suman's Search for a Lawyer
episodesList.summary: Suman's grandfather decides to work on the case, but soon enough, he experiences poor health conditions. Later, she visits a lawyer and requests him to fight her case. What happens next? Tune in to find out!

episodesList.title: Suman Files a Case
episodesList.summary: Mr. Tiwari and Suman visits the court to file the case. However, he starts feeling dizzy in the chaos of the court premises. On finding out that their lawyer is Khosla's friend, Mr. Tiwari decides to fight the case himself. How will he manage to handle the pressure of the case amidst his deteriorating heath?

episodesList.title: Khosla Attempts to Get the Property
episodesList.summary: Shravan, Suman and her grandfather, submit the documents at the court. Shravan assures Suman's family that he will save his house. Will he be able to keep his promise? Keep watching to find out!

episodesList.title: Khosla's Plan
episodesList.summary: Khosla spots Varun talking with his assistant and comes to know that Varun is Shravan's cousin. Shravan visits Suman's family to discuss about the case. Suman gets nostalgic to visit her mother's house.

episodesList.title: Papers of Tiwari Villa
episodesList.summary: Suman discusses with Shravan, the tough times she's been through. Later, they get locked in the house by Khosla's assistant. Will they be able to get out? Tune in to find out?

episodesList.title: First Hearing of the Property Case
episodesList.summary: Suman and Shravan continue searching for vital pieces of evidence about the property case against Khosla, they are caught by Khosla intruding his property. Suman and his grandfather arrive at the court for the first hearing of the case.

episodesList.title: Thank You Bouquet
episodesList.summary: Khosla calls Babulal and tries to bribe him. Suman wants to thank Shravan by giving him a bouquet. Is she falling in love with Shravan? Tune in to witness the story unfold!

episodesList.title: Childhood Memories
episodesList.summary: Suman arrives at Shravan's house to delete the message from his phone and locks him in the bathroom in the process. Ramnath and Pushkar return home but they are still disappointed with Shravan's decision. Will they forgive him?

episodesList.title: Case Hearing Day
episodesList.summary: Suman and her family arrive at the court for the hearing of their property case. Khosla and his lawyer, with the help of false evidences makes a strong move in the case. Will Shravan be able to outsmart Khosla and his lawyer? Only one way to find out, keep watching!

episodesList.title: Suman's Attempt to Stop Manju
episodesList.summary: Suman and Shravan rush to Khosla's office just to stop Manju, she wants to sell her house to Khosla. Suman doesn't want to let her grandfather know about this. Will she succeed? Watch the episode to find out!

episodesList.title: Deal to Save the House
episodesList.summary: Shravan's father teaches him a rule to become a great lawyer. Shravan offers a nice deal to Khosla, to save Suman's house. Suman gets to know about the deal and goes to Shravan's house to confront him. What is this deal? Watch the episode to find out!

episodesList.title: Manju's Proposal
episodesList.summary: The Tiwari family is relieved, except Suman and her grandfather, who wants to give Shravan's money back. Manju is still adamant to sell the house to Khosla. Shravan visits Khosla's office. Watch the episode to witness the interesting turn of events.

episodesList.title: Shravan's Plan
episodesList.summary: Shravan visits Tiwari house to explain his plan to the family for saving their house. Meanwhile, Sumo and Shravan start bonding again. Members of the Tiwari family arrive at Khosla's office to seek his help. What help do they need? Watch the episode to find out!

episodesList.title: Shastri's Truth
episodesList.summary: Shravan and Suman are following Khosla's assistant, in the hope of finding some clue. Finally they got to know about Shastri's address, he is the person who can copy anyone's signature. Tune in to know what happens next?

episodesList.title: Burai Se Ladna Zaruri Hai
episodesList.summary: Kamini asks Shravan to reach home immediately. Varun decides to leave the house. Later, Suman asks Shravan to drop the case.

episodesList.title: Khosla in Police Custody
episodesList.summary: Khosla's court case is scheduled for the next day. However, just before the important hearing of the property case, Suman requests Shravan to back out from the case. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Courts Verdict Against Khosla
episodesList.summary: Devendra Khosla's verdict is now going to be announced soon. The honourable court concludes the hearing of the case and sends him in police custody for 30 days. However, just after the verdict, Kholsa starts having a heart attack. Stay tuned to find out more.

episodesList.title: Dinner at Sumans'
episodesList.summary: Shravana is about to go to Suman's house for dinner. However, on the call, Shravan asks her to pay her dues. Suman gets confused as to what could he mean by it. Watch the episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Rooftop Meeting
episodesList.summary: While Shravan and Suman's family is busy playing 'Anatakshri', both of them separately go to the roof for a chat. Shravan confesses his feelings to Suman. However, she seems disappointed upon hearing what he had to say.

episodesList.title: Tom Uncle's Tea Stall
episodesList.summary: Suman desperately tries to contact Shravan in the middle of the night. She tries to message and to ring him up, but she does not get a reply.  However, during the early morning hours, Shravan calls her back, and they both decide to meet each at Tom's tea stall.

episodesList.title: Love Shuv Ki Baatein
episodesList.summary: Pritha wants to know about Shravan's feeling for Suman. She pesters Suman to find out Shravan's feelings for her. She is suggesting a few tips to test Shravan feelings! Stay tuned to find out more.

episodesList.title: Pushkar Wins His First Case
episodesList.summary: Suman tries to know about Shravan's feeling for her. She is following Pritha's ideas, but unluckily it doesn't work on Shravan. On the other hand, Pushkar has won the first case of his life and his family members are seen celebrating his grand win!

episodesList.title: Shravan Decides to Go Back to London
episodesList.summary: Suman is trying to convince Shravan to stay back in India and find a solution to the problems of his family. She tries her best, but nothing comes out of it. Shravan feels that he shouldn't create unnecessary differences in his family and hence decides to go back to London

episodesList.title: Suman's Plan for Shravan
episodesList.summary: Suman makes a fabulous plan to spend quality time with her childhood friend Shravan. She calls him and asks to join her in the plan, but Shravan had to attend a family wedding hence; Suman's plan gets cancelled. However, just before leaving for the marriage ceremony, Shravan strains his ankle. Everyone advises him to stay back in the house and to take rest some rest.

episodesList.title: Suman Hides Shravan's Passport
episodesList.summary: Shravan searches for his passport, but he is unable to find it. It is Suman, who hides his passport secretly inside a drawer. However, later in the episode, Suman gives back his passport and admits that she did it on purpose. Find out more by watching the episode.

episodesList.title: Disturbing News
episodesList.summary: Suman feels that she should have expressed her feeling to Shravan, but now it's too late. However, prior to him leaving for London, Shravan comes to meet Suman in her house. Both childhood friends spend quality time together by reliving their childhood memories! Later, Shravan departs for the airport and it was then Suman gets some disturbing news.

episodesList.title: Shravan Grieves
episodesList.summary: Shravan is in deep grief after knowing that his father's plane crashed. He is mourning in pain thinking that his father is no more. He recollects all his memories and misses his father. Watch the episode to find out more.

episodesList.title: Ramnath Appreciates Suman
episodesList.summary: Suman arrives at Shravan's house during the early morning hours. She met Mr Ramanth in the lawn and accompanied him over morning tea. Mr Ramnath was very impressed with Suman and, he appreciates her for the support and care which she showed for her childhood friend Sharvan.

episodesList.title: Suman Is in Love With Shravan
episodesList.summary: Preeti informs Suman that the family members are planning to fix her marriage. But, on the other hand, she is in love with her childhood friend Shravan and, she wants to marry him. However, she now wants to make Shravan feel jealous by informing him about her family member's decision to fix her marriage.

episodesList.title: Shravan Ki Nafrat
episodesList.summary: Suman playfully informs Vandy about Shravan's decision of getting married. Everyone in his family starts teasing him and wants to know about his choice. Mr Ramnath too wants to see his son getting married soon, but Shravan has a completely different view. He informs everyone that he doesn't trust women and would never marry in his whole life!

episodesList.title: Suman's Question for Shravan
episodesList.summary: Suman is eager to know what Shravan thinks about women. And, even more than that, she wants to know what her childhood friend, Shravan, thinks about her. Meanwhile, Shravan is stuck in an important meeting. Stay tuned to find out more.

episodesList.title: Shravan Challenges Pushkar
episodesList.summary: Sharvan is eager to know about the cook, who has prepared a mouth-watering dal for their lunch. Shravan thinks that the cook is definitely a male and not a female. Moreover, he bets Pushkar on this and contacts the kitchen that cooked the meal for him.

episodesList.title: Nirmala at Tiwari Villa
episodesList.summary: Nirmala (Shravan's mother) is at Suman's house, to meet her family. Suman informs her that Shravan too is present in their house at the moment. Nirmala asks Suman to handle the situation and send Shravan out.

episodesList.title: Pushkar's One Sided Love Story
episodesList.summary: Nirmala sees photographs of Shravan on his friend's book account, she wants to meet her son after so many years. Nirmala asks Suman to call Shravan to his favourite place, without informing him about her. On the other side, Pushkar wants to propose Preeti but is fearing to do so. They both meet up in a park but will Pushkar propose her?

episodesList.title: Shravan's Childhood Memories
episodesList.summary: Suman convinces Shravan to come along with her to the book shop. Nirmala, who is present in the book shop is just admiring her child. She is hiding behind the bookshelves and observes him from a distance. What will happen now? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Nirmala Ki Beeti Yaadein
episodesList.summary: Suman is trying her best to know about the truth behind Nirmala's decision to leave her family 10 years back. She wants to know all the details which compelled Nirmala to take a harsh decision like this where she left behind her own child Sharvan. Watch now on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: MasterChef Suman's Dal Recipe
episodesList.summary: This episode continues with Shravan discovering the truth behind the Dal's recipe. He gets to know that Dhurandhar Singh Bagga is a fraud and doesn't know cooking at all. Dhurandhar confesses that it is Suman.Watch now only on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Pushkar's Date With Preeti
episodesList.summary: Pushkar points out to Shravan that he has won the bet and according to the rules, Shravan will now have to fulfill his promise. He asks Shravan to book a table for two at a very famous restaurant in Delhi.

episodesList.title: Suman's Date With Shravan
episodesList.summary: Suman and Shravan meeting in a famous restaurant, in Delhi, and deciding to have dinner together. It is Pushkar, who had earlier insisted Shravan to reserve a table for two at the restaurant.

episodesList.title: Nirmala's Gift for Sharvan
episodesList.summary: Nirmala wants to gift Shravan a book on vintage cars but she wants Suman to present the gift on her behalf. Nirmala insists Suman to not to reveal her name before Shravan.Watch now on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Shravan Avoids Suman
episodesList.summary: Shravan attends the conference meeting with his clients in his office. Pushkar discusses the details of the case but Shravan is lost in his thoughts, thinking about Suman.

episodesList.title: Suman's Text Message to Shravan
episodesList.summary: Pushkar calls Suman from Shravan's mobile phone. She thinks that Shravan has called her up to know about her health, but she gets a shock on hearing Pushkar's voice.

episodesList.title: Shravan Missing His Childhood Friend
episodesList.summary: This episode continues with Shravan waiting for Suman in his office, but she arrives late. Shravan gets impatient and scolds her and makes her realize that since their childhood days Suman has kept him waiting during several instances.

episodesList.title: Shravan's Bitter Memories
episodesList.summary: Pushkar questions Suman about her feelings for Shravan but she keeps denying it. Pushkar insists Suman to speak with Shravan and to clear the misunderstanding between the two.

episodesList.title: Mr. Ramnath Spots Nirmala in Court
episodesList.summary: Mr. Ramnath spotting his wife, Nirmala, on the court premises. He becomes tensed after seeing her and feels that Nirmala must have some or the other motive for which she has come to Delhi. Watch now on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Ramnath Warns Nirmala
episodesList.summary: Mr. Ramnath meeting his wife, Nirmala at Tiwari Villa. He is very furious and wants to warn her to stay away from his son, Shravan. Mr. Ramnath thinks that she has come to Delhi with some  other motive.

episodesList.title: Suman Proves Her Trust for Shravan
episodesList.summary: Everyone at the party probes Shravan regarding Suman and also updates him about several stories going around regarding Suman and him.

episodesList.title: Mr. Ramnath Scolds Suman
episodesList.summary: Suman tries to make Mr. Ramnath understand the sufferings of her childhood friend Shravan. She stresses that Shravan needs the love and care of his mother.

episodesList.title: Dent in the Relation
episodesList.summary: Shravan's father is quite infuriated to see Shravan and his estranged mother together. He does not let Shravan utter even a single word and in anger leaves the place. Shravan, on the other hand, starts yelling at Suman.

episodesList.title: Kamini's Failed Plan
episodesList.summary: Kamini and Vandy are devising an excellent plan to compel Shravan to leave his home and to return back to London. To execute her plan, she approaches Shravan to convince him to take a break from his hectic work schedule.

episodesList.title: Suman Apologizes for Her Mistake
episodesList.summary: Suman is feeling guilty for hurting her childhood friend, Shravan, and Mr. Ramnath. She now wants to meet Shravan and apologize for her mistake but he is not ready to speak with her.

episodesList.title: Mr. Ramnath Finds Shravan's Letter
episodesList.summary: Shravan is very angry with his childhood friend, Suman, he is constantly refusing to accept Suman's theory behind making him meet his mother, Nirmala. Watch now on SontLIV.

episodesList.title: Court Order to Vacate PCT
episodesList.summary: Suman gets a huge catering order for her tiffin service company. She is very happy about it. Suman even gets an advance payment for the order, which she hands over to her maternal aunt.

episodesList.title: Shravan Hurts Suman
episodesList.summary: Suman gets a confirmation that it is her childhood friend, Shravan, who is the lawyer of Mr. Berry. She reads the court order and thinks that he will surely help her in order to save her catering business.

episodesList.title: Mr. Ramnath and Kamini's Plan
episodesList.summary: Mr. Ramnath is making plans to create differences between Shravan and Suman. He along with Kamini is making a strategy to create differences between the two so that Suman gets out of Shravan's mind forever.

episodesList.title: Shravan Challenges Suman
episodesList.summary: To execute his master plan, Mr. Ramnath starts laying traps to create differences between the two childhood friends, Shravan and Suman. He very cautiously goes to inform Shravan that he has bought the portion of land. Will Shravan and Suman fall into his trap? Tune in to find out what happens next.

episodesList.title: Pushkar Wants to Propose Preeti
episodesList.summary: After PCT getting closed, Suman gets a bulk order to prepare food for 500 people. She is a courageous girl and decides to prepare the meal at her house. However, on the other side, Pushkar is in love with Preeti. Will Suman be able to finish her order? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Suman Meets With an Accident
episodesList.summary: Suman gets a huge round of applause from her customers for preparing an excellent meal for them. However, Suman contacts a property dealer to find a place for her catering business. Later, she meets with an accident with Shravan. Watch the episode to find out more.

episodesList.title: Shravan Feels Guilty
episodesList.summary: Shravan is feeling guilty for his uncertain behaviour towards Suman. He thinks that he could have helped her and he could have easily averted the accident. What will Shravan do next? Tune in to find out.

episodesList.title: Shravan Blames Himself for the Accident
episodesList.summary: Shravan reaches hospital as he is feeling guilty. He think that he could have avoided Suman's accident. He wants to look after his childhood friend.  Watch the episode to find out more.

episodesList.title: Suman Got Discharged From Hospital
episodesList.summary: After days of rigorous treatment and cure, Suman gets discharged from the hospital. However, she is still unable to move her body. On the other hand, Shravan is constantly taking care of her.

episodesList.title: Suman's Road to Recovery
episodesList.summary: Shravan takes care of Suman and ensures that she exercises in order to get strong and recover soon. Inadvertently, they both get to hear Pushkar and Preeti's call and get alarmed.

episodesList.title: Suman Ka Gussa
episodesList.summary: Suman is on complete bed rest after meeting with an accident. She thinks that she can never recover from her illness. She is tensed by thinking that she can never work in the kitchen of her catering services. Will she be able to recover from this? watch the episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Shravan's Magic on Suman
episodesList.summary: Suman's health is recovering back to normal after meeting with the accident. Everyone in her house is praying for her speedy recovery. Shravan is constantly taking care of her and helping her recovery.

episodesList.title: Shravan Shares His Feelings With Mr. Ramnath
episodesList.summary: After Suman gets to know the truth that Shravan is not involved with her catering business getting ruined. She starts feeling guilty and wants to meet her childhood friend, Shravan immediately. Will they resolve their differences? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Kamini's Game Plan
episodesList.summary: Kamini is executing her game plan to keep Suman away from Shravan's life. Will Kamini Succeed or Will Shravan and Suman resolve their differences? Tune in to find out more.

episodesList.title: Mr. Tiwari Wants to Meet Ramnath
episodesList.summary: Mr. Tiwari is calling Mr. Ramnath to know about his will to discuss Neha and Ranbeer's marriage. Shocked Kamini, starts making plans to create a barrier between the two. Watch this episode to find out what happens next.

episodesList.title: Kamini Agrees for Pushkar and Preeti's Wedding
episodesList.summary: Kamini agrees to Pushkar's wedding with Preeti. Everyone in the Tiwari family is happy with Mr. Ramnath and Kamini's decision. Tune in to find out more.

episodesList.title: Mr. Ramnath Threatens Suman
episodesList.summary: Mr. Ramnath is threatening Suman to keep away from his son, Shravan. He is handing over a blank cheque as compensation to sacrifice her love for Shravan. Mr. Ramnath even points out that she is an independent girl. Will Suman accept the cheque? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Mr. Ramnath's Ultimatum to Suman
episodesList.summary: Mr. Ramnath is trying to manipulate Shravan's decision of marrying his childhood friend, Suman. He is trying all the tricks citing the example of his failed relationship. Will he be able to change Shravan's decision? Tune in to find out.

episodesList.title: Muharat of Preeti's Marriage
episodesList.summary: Shravan is thinking about Suman, but at the same time, his mind is preoccupied with Mr. Ramnath's wordings. What will be Shravan's decision? Watch this episode to find out more.

episodesList.title: Shravan's Faith in Suman
episodesList.summary: Both families are reasoning and arguing regarding wedding location and rituals. Shravan confers with Suman for missing the coffee meet up with him. Tune in to find out what happens next.

episodesList.title: Pushkar and Preeti's Engagement
episodesList.summary: The Tiwari's have gathered at Malhotra's house for the Tilak ceremony but suddenly Kamini comes up with the idea of a ring ceremony between the two. It creates an embarrassing movement for the Tiwari's.

episodesList.title: The Ring Ceremony
episodesList.summary: It's Pushkar and Preeti's engagement ceremony and within a very short span time the groom's side has made a perfect arrangement for the party.

episodesList.title: Shravan and Suman's Dance Rehearsal
episodesList.summary: Suman and Shravan both come together to finalize a banquet hall for Pushkar and Preeti's Sangeet ceremony. It's a beautiful banquet hall but still, Shravan points out that it is Kamini's special request to book a banquet in a five-star hotel.

episodesList.title: Pushkar and Preeti's Sangeet Ceremony
episodesList.summary: Preeti insists that Suman and Shravan should dance together in her Sangeet ceremony. Everyone in the family, including Kamini, agrees and backs Preeti's idea of the two childhood friends to dance together.

episodesList.title: Shravan's Jealousy
episodesList.summary: Suman starts making proper arrangements for Pushkar and Preeti's Sangeet ceremony. However, the function starts with some mind-blowing performances on the dance floor. Everyone is very impressed with how the event has been organized.

episodesList.title: Shravan Feels Jealous
episodesList.summary: A young and handsome man approaches Suman to allow him to dance with her in the Sangeet Ceremony. Before Suman could figure out anything, her name gets announced for her performance.

episodesList.title: Suman Avoids Shravan
episodesList.summary: Suman meets her friend, Aditya, in a cafe. Shravan comes to know about Aditya and tries to find out everything about their relationship. Coincidentally, Shravan comes to the same cafe where Suman was.

episodesList.title: Shravan Gets Jealous of Aditya
episodesList.summary: Aditya prepares a sweet dish and serves it to Suman. Aditya learns that Shravan is Suman's childhood friend.

episodesList.title: Pushkar and Preeti's Haldi Ceremony
episodesList.summary: Anuj's mother tells her family that Anuj is diagnosed with typhoid. Pushkar calls Preeti and tells her that he wishes to meet her before their wedding.

episodesList.title: Shravan's Anger
episodesList.summary: Suman advises Shravan to keep his anger under control. Anuj's mother tells her family that she wishes to go to America after attending Preeti's wedding. On the other hand, Pushkar comes to Priti's house.

episodesList.title: Pushkar's Bachelor Party
episodesList.summary: Nanaji scolds his family for being selfish and not looking after his daughter. Shravan calls Suman, but Preeti answers the call and informs Shravan that Suman is not at home.

episodesList.title: Shravan's Hatred
episodesList.summary: Shravan drops Aditya to a restaurant in his car. Aditya thanks Shravan and suggests him to meet his girlfriend. But, Shravan refuses to wait and moves out of the place.

episodesList.title: Suman's Love
episodesList.summary: Suman hugs Shravan and tells him that she was concerned for his safety. Suman clears it to Ramnath that she loves Shravan. The next morning, Aditya brings Suman to a big building.

episodesList.title: Suman Ki Kashmakash
episodesList.summary: Aditya tells Suman that they need to prepare a presentation regarding their new venture. Suman makes it clear to Aditya that she will be busy managing Pushkar's wedding ceremony for a couple of days.

episodesList.title: Suman's New Challenge
episodesList.summary: Two food inspectors enter Suman's house. They angrily ask her not to run the business from home. Shravan learns that Suman gets asked to run her business from a different location.

episodesList.title: Suman Ki Samasya
episodesList.summary: Suman requests Ravi Sinha to offer her a place to run her food business. Ravi agrees to arrange a place for Suman's business. However, he complains about Shravan's attitude towards Sonakshi. Sonakshi angrily walks out of Ravi Sinha's office.

episodesList.title: Samir Gets a Job Abroad
episodesList.summary: Suman tells Shravan that Kamini should not have doubted her ability to manage Preeti's wedding function. Shravan requests Suman not to take Kamini's criticism personally.

episodesList.title: Suman Aur Shravan Ki Badhti Duriyan
episodesList.summary: Suman calls a doctor to the house to check on Nanaji. The doctor tells Suman's family that they must admit Nanaji to a hospital. Aditya meets Shravan and apologizes for hurting his feelings. Suman's family informs Kamini about Nanaji's ailing health.

episodesList.title: Ramnath Meets Kamini
episodesList.summary: Shravan informs his brother Pushkar that Nanaji is not keeping well. Ramnath comes to Nanaji's house to enquire about his health. Ramnath promises Nanaji that he would look after Suman in the future.

episodesList.title: Shravan's Misunderstanding
episodesList.summary: Sameer and Suman come to Kamini's house. Sameer praises Kamini for agreeing to Nanaji's wish. Suman thanks Aditya for supporting her during difficult times. Shravan secretly listens to Suman and Aditya's discussion.

episodesList.title: Aditya Buys Shravan's Property
episodesList.summary: Pushkar suggests Aditya not to help Suman in her business. Aditya meets Shravan and requests him to give him one of his properties. Shravan refuses to give up the property to Aditya.

episodesList.title: Shravan's Helps Suman
episodesList.summary: Aditya tells Shravan that he wishes to return his property to Suman. Shravan hands over the property papers to Aditya. Aditya is thankful for Shravan for helping.

episodesList.title: Shravan Breaks Friendship With Suman
episodesList.summary: Aditya shows Suman's photograph to his mother. He informs her that he wishes to marry Suman. Aditya's mother advises him not to attend Pushkar's wedding. Shravan enters Suman's new workplace furiously.

episodesList.title: Aditya's Love for Suman
episodesList.summary: Shravan tells Ramnath that he is deeply hurt due to Suman's behaviour. Nirmala informs Nanaji that Aditya has fallen for Suman. Ramnath informs Shravan that Suman's grandfather has suffered a heart attack.

episodesList.title: Suman Ki Duvidha
episodesList.summary: Suman assures her grandfather that she is ready to marry Aditya. Preeti learns that Suman is unwilling to marry Aditya as she loves Shravan. Preeti asks Suman to reconsider her decision.

episodesList.title: Pushkar and Preeti's Wedding
episodesList.summary: Tiwari and Malhotra families greet each other on the occasion of Pushkar and Preeti's wedding. Suman's grandfather gives his blessings to the newly wedded couple. Aditya secretly meets Suman in a room and expresses his feelings for her.

episodesList.title: Aditya Declares His Marriage Plans
episodesList.summary: Pushkar and Preeti complete their marriage rituals in front of their family members. Nanaji performs Preeti's kanyadaan and gives blessings to the married couple.

episodesList.title: Preeti Aur Pushkar Ki Shaadi
episodesList.summary: Preeti and Pushkar get married to each other. Preeti bids farewell to her family. Later, Shravan welcomes the newly wedded couple to the Malhotra house.

episodesList.title: Nirmala's Secret Is Out
episodesList.summary: Aditya requests Shravan to look after Suman in his absence. Suman tells Shravan that she has agreed to marry Aditya due to family compulsion.

episodesList.title: Shravan Ki Narazgi
episodesList.summary: Shravan notices Nirmala's photo in Aditya's mobile phone. He furiously walks out of the room. Kamini tells Aditya that Shravan is Nirmala's son.

episodesList.title: Aditya Aur Shravan Ka Rishta
episodesList.summary: Aditya meets Suman to enquire about her estranged relationship with Shravan. Suman refuses to reveal her secret to Aditya. Nanaji suggests Shravan to not attend Suman's wedding.

episodesList.title: Nirmala Ki Duvidha
episodesList.summary: Aditya tells Nirmala that Shravan doesn't care for her anymore. Nirmala calls Ramnath and requests him to keep Shravan away from Aditya's wedding. Kamini suggests Shravan to fight for his love.

episodesList.title: Suman Scolds Aditya
episodesList.summary: Aditya requests Shravan to invite Suman's schoolmates to her wedding. Suman yells at Aditya for interfering in her personal life. Kamini secretly listens to Suman and Aditya's heated discussion.

episodesList.title: Aditya Notices Shravan's Feelings for Suman
episodesList.summary: Preeti returns home from shopping and meets Kamini. Kamini advises Preeti to not hide any secrets from her. Aditya asks Suman as to why she never expressed her love openly to him.

episodesList.title: Aditya Plans Bachelor Party
episodesList.summary: Aditya writes his name with mehendi on Suman's hand. Later, Aditya invites Shravan to a bachelor's party. Shravan accepts the invitation and comes to the party organized by Aditya.

episodesList.title: Aditya Ki Duvidha
episodesList.summary: Aditya comes to Suman's house at midnight. He tells Suman's aunt that he wishes to meet Suman. Suman's aunt advises Aditya to go back to his house. The next day, Aditya calls Suman but she refuses to answer the calls.

episodesList.title: Suman Breaks Up With Aditya
episodesList.summary: Aditya enters Suman's room and angrily asks her to prove her love for him. Shravan's hears noise from Suman's room. He intrudes into the room and beats Aditya for misbehaving with Suman.

episodesList.title: Shravan Brings Tulips for Suman
episodesList.summary: Ramnath tells Shravan that he is proud of him as he saved Suman from Aditya. Shravan tells Ramnath that he would find a groom for Suman as promised to her grandfather.

episodesList.title: Suman Aur Shravan Ki Duvidha
episodesList.summary: Kamini tells Raghuveer that Shravan and Suman love each other a lot. She advises the Tiwari family to plan for their marriage. Suman's grandfather calls her and Shravan to his house.

episodesList.title: Shravan Refuses to Marry Suman
episodesList.summary: Suman's aunt tells her that she can't go to America till she gets married. She advises Suman to marry Shravan. Suman calls Shravan and tells him that their families are anxiously waiting to know their wedding plans.

episodesList.title: Shravan and Suman Agree to Marry
episodesList.summary: Kamini tells Shravan that Raghuveer Tiwari has compelled Ramnath to offer him Gurudakshina. The next morning, Raghuveer invites Suman and Shravan to his house.

episodesList.title: Ramnath Angry at Shravan
episodesList.summary: Ramnath tells Raghuveer that he would bear the expenses of Shravan's wedding. Suman clears it to Ramnath that she wants to keep her wedding a low-key affair.

episodesList.title: Shravan and Suman Get Married
episodesList.summary: Shravan tells Suman that they should have a lavish wedding. Suman resists the suggestion and replies to Shravan that she would rather prefer a simple wedding.

episodesList.title: Suman Shocks Her Family
episodesList.summary: Suman shocks her family by revealing that she is married to Shravan. Suman's grandfather asks her the reason for marrying in haste. Nirmala tells Aditya that they should go back to Mumbai. What happens next? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Aditya Kidnaps Shravan
episodesList.summary: Suman's grandfather blesses her and Shravan for their marital life. Ramnath tells Shravan that he should not have married in the court. Shravan comforts his father and requests him to calm down. Watch this episode for more.

episodesList.title: Aditya Provokes Shravan to Fight
episodesList.summary: Aditya tells Shravan that he is going to teach him a lesson for his past mistakes. Ramnath makes a call to Nirmala. He anxiously tells her that Shravan is missing since morning.

episodesList.title: Shravan Is Getting Tensed for Suman
episodesList.summary: Shravan makes a call to Ramnath. He tells Ramnath that he met with a minor accident and thus could not contact him. Shravan comes to Suman's house and meets Pushkar. Watch this episode to know more.

episodesList.title: Suman Enters Shravan's House
episodesList.summary: Preeti requests Suman to wear a traditional saree as she prepares to leave her house. Shravan brings Suman to his house. Kamini welcomes the newly wedded couple. Shravan and Suman take blessings from Ramnath.

episodesList.title: Shravan Ki Kashmakash
episodesList.summary: Ramnath tells Kamini that he has accepted Suman and Shravan's marriage. A servant tells Shravan that he wishes to go to his house. Shravan stops him and asks to serve him a glass of drink.

episodesList.title: Shravan Ki Duvidha
episodesList.summary: Bahadur tells Kamini that Shravan had forced him to drink liquor along with him. Preeti enters Suman's room. Shravan learns that his wife, Suman, is not home. What will Shravan do?

episodesList.title: Tiwari Family Comes to Shravan's House
episodesList.summary: Shravan tells Ramnath that he hates Suman a lot. Ramnath tells Shravan that he shouldn't have married Suman. Raghuveer Tiwari makes a call to Kamini. Kamini invites him for dinner.

episodesList.title: Shravan's Secret Is Out
episodesList.summary: Suman returns home and meets her family. Shravan advises Suman to not lie to his family members. Suman angrily asks Shravan as to why he misled Aditya by making up a story about her pre-marital affair. What will Shravan reply?

episodesList.title: Suman Settles Scores With Shravan
episodesList.summary: Suman's family requests her to wear her wedding dress and ornaments. Shravan's aunt advises Suman to apply vermillion on the forehead with the hands of Shravan. Will Suman agree? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Shravan Aur Suman Ki Duriyan
episodesList.summary: Ramnath advises Shravan to stay away from alcohol. Shravan apologizes to his father. The next morning, an investor meets Suman in her restaurant. Suman tells the investor that she wishes to expand her venture. Will the investor help her out?

episodesList.title: Suman Prepares Food for Her Family
episodesList.summary: Suman politely suggests Kamini to not interfere in her personal affairs. She assures Kamini that she can handle her problems on her own. A real estate agent shows a place to Shravan for his new office. Will Shravan like it?

episodesList.title: Shravan Insults Suman in Front of Media
episodesList.summary: Shravan tells the real estate agent that he wants to open his new office near Suman's restaurant. Suman taunts Shravan that he may not be able to grow his business on his own. What will Shravan say to this? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Ramnath Reveals Nirmala's Secret to Shravan
episodesList.summary: Tiwari family watch the news of Shravan and Suman's break-up on television. Suman tells her grandfather that she has left Shravan's house. Ramnath informs Shravan that Nirmala is his estranged wife. How will Shravan react?

episodesList.title: Shravan Reunites With Suman
episodesList.summary: Shravan comes to Suman's restaurant. He apologizes to Suman for his past mistakes. He requests Suman to come back to his house. Suman clears it to Shravan that she can't accept his proposal unless he forgives Nirmala. Will Shravan forgive Nirmala?

episodesList.title: Suman Cant Stand Shravan
episodesList.summary: Suman is a disciplined army kid. Her life is all about rules and consequences, until she meets Shravan. Shravan is a civilian, and a brat too. While they do not see each others faces, Suman brands Shravan a thief because of his foolhardy actions. They are new neighbours and are about to meet at the same Army event. What will happen when they will realize that their fathers are friends?

episodesList.title: Suman Meets Shravan
episodesList.summary: Col. Tiwari is being honoured in an Army Event. Shravan goes there with his father. Suman finally meets him. They start off on the wrong foot when Suman realises that Shravan is the same "thief she had chased earlier in the day, and when Shravan realises she has his prized cricket match ticket, all hell breaks loose.

episodesList.title: Shravan Goes to the Army School
episodesList.summary: Shravan's family attends the army lunch. There, Suman is praised for being the first female cadet to lead her school in the 26th January parade. However, Shravan, who was already having a bad day, sees his fortune go from bad to worse when his activities are exposed before his father. Suman then recommends to Shravan's father, Devraj, to send him to the Army Public School. Devraj readily decides to do the same.

episodesList.title: Suman Punishes Shravan
episodesList.summary: Shravan thinks that he will be rejected from the army school, because of the long selection process. Unexpectedly, he gets inducted on his very first day. Suman and Shravan are present in the assembly. Shravan misbehaves in the assembly, and Suman punishes him for it.

episodesList.title: Shravan Ignores Sumans Warning
episodesList.summary: Shravan and Suman's friction escalates further when Suman warns Shravan and reminds him to behave appropriately. Shravan, however, does the opposite and challenges the status quo at school. The situation goes out of hand. The battle between Army versus civilian's kids begins.

episodesList.title: Shravan Is in Trouble
episodesList.summary: Team Army Kids trouble Shravan at the school.

episodesList.title: Shravans Rebellion Continues
episodesList.summary: In the auditorium, Shravan announces in front of all the students that this year civilian kids will participate in the 26th January fest. However, Suman is not in favour of this unnecessary rebellion. When Shravan sees that not even a single civilian kid is showing enthusiasm, he decides to encourage and unite them

episodesList.title: Shravan Challenges Aneesh
episodesList.summary: Shravan unites the entire civilian students and motivates them to be a part of the fest. Shravan then challenges Aneesh and promises him to change the status quo. Shravan views Suman as a de facto enemy in this fight.

episodesList.title: Shravan and Aneeshs Fist Fight
episodesList.summary: Due to Shravans meddling, Aneesh loses out on the play and Shravan becomes the lead. This angers Aneesh and he gets into a fist fight with Shravan. The news reaches the Principals ears. He gets upset and brings in the Army-Civilian buddy system. Despite Shravan and Sumans unwillingness, they are paired together.

episodesList.title: Suman Is Stuck in Partnership
episodesList.summary: Suman tries her hard but fails in changing the budding pairing. She finally gives in and tells Shravan that they will be buddies only inside the school. What will Suman do now?

episodesList.title: Suman and Shravan Be Buddies?
episodesList.summary: Suman and Sharavan spend their first day as buddies. But they argue and disagree on almost everything. Finally, the day ends well for Shravan as he is mesmerized by Sumans performance in the play rehearsal.

episodesList.title: Shravan vs the Bullies
episodesList.summary: Shravan stands up for a weak friend against the bullies. This impresses Suman. Devika too gets impressed with Shravan's act and starts bonding with him. Suman senses Shravan's intentions towards Devika. What will she do now?

episodesList.title: Shravan Sees Suman Cry
episodesList.summary: When Shravan tries to apologize for his mistake, he notices Suman crying for a soldier's death.

episodesList.title: Shravan & Suman Are Unable to Rehearse
episodesList.summary: Shravan and Suman are not able to rehearse for the play, due to their lack of understanding towards each other. So they decide to meet outside their school, in a cafe to understand each other as it will help them rehearse. Shravan and Suman discover each others true nature in this interaction. Will this interaction reduce the hatred in them?Lets find out.

episodesList.title: Suman Is Jealous
episodesList.summary: Suman gets irritated with Shravan when he leaves to meet Devika without informing her. Later, Shravan insists that he and Suman should meet again. They meet at Shravans place for play rehearsals. There, a moment of understanding develops between them. Suman gets impressed seeing Shravans trophies and medals. However, Suman is still doubtful of Shravans achievements as she is totally unaware of this side of him.

episodesList.title: Suman Traps Shravan
episodesList.summary: Shravans dad gives him a responsibility to handover a file in the army cantonment. Meanwhile, Suman also decides to go to the cantonment with her mother as she is going to the Army Wives Welfare Association for a meeting to help a Subedars Daughter-In-Law. Shravan and Suman end up meeting in the cantonment. Later, Suman traps Shravan into playing a badminton game with her father, Vijay. Will Shravan win against Vijay?

episodesList.title: Shravan Accepts Suman’s Challenge
episodesList.summary: Shravan plays the "dont blink your eyes game with Devika and lies that he cannot look at Devika anymore as he sees his dead ex-girlfriend in her eyes. Devika believes him and is shattered. Suman challenges Shravan to impress her grandfather. Shravan accepts the challenge. Shravan wakes up early to join Suman and her grandfather for a jog but he finds impressing the grandfather not that easy.

episodesList.title: Shravan Is Caught Lying
episodesList.summary: Shravan doesn't show up for the game against Suman's grandfather and lies about his absence. Suman knows that Shravan has lied about his absence. Will Shravan be able to justify his behaviour?

episodesList.title: Shravan Loses the Bet
episodesList.summary: Shravan applies a chess tactic from an old film while playing against Sumans grandfather. He still does not succeed in winning the chess game. Suman is ecstatic and makes Shravan agree to do the things according to her wishes, as the prize of winning the bet against Shravan.

episodesList.title: Vijay Leaves for a Mission
episodesList.summary: Sumans father, Vijay, who is in the army, has to leave for an important mission without meeting Suman. When Suman gets upset when she returns home and finds her father gone. She is unhappy because they hadnt met before her father left for the mission. Suman confides in Shravan. Shravan wants Suman to meet her father before its too late to meet him. They set off to meet Vijay. Will Suman be able to meet her father before he departs?

episodesList.title: Suman Worries About Vijay
episodesList.summary: Suman and Shravan hang out and go to eat local food. Meanwhile, Shravan keeps receiving calls from Devika but lies to Suman about the same. Suman thinks Shravan is irresponsible since he has forgotten his wallet including his license. Hence, she doesnt sit with him on his bike and goes home in an auto. This annoys Shravan. The following morning, the Tiwari family gets to know through Television News that Vijay and his team have been injured. Suman is extremely worried and hence skips school. Shravan having felt Sumans absence in school, decides to give her a call after school.

episodesList.title: Shravan’s Family Consoles the Tiwaris
episodesList.summary: Shravan calls Suman who tells him about Vijays injury. Shravan and his family visit the Tiwaris house to console them. Suman likes Shravan's gesture. An injured Vijay returns home. The family is happy and emotional on seeing him. Shravan and Suman are now friends. Shravan lies about his relationship with Devika. Meanwhile, an emotional scene unfolds about Sumans grandfathers dream.

episodesList.title: Shravan Lies Again
episodesList.summary: Suman meets Bunty on her way to the hospital with her grandfather and her father. There she comes to know about Shravan's lie. What will she do now?

episodesList.title: Shravan’s Mother Knows About His Relationship
episodesList.summary: Suman unintentionally reveals to Shravan's mother about his girlfriend. How will she react?

episodesList.title: Shravan and Suman Fight
episodesList.summary: Shravan and Suman end up fighting when Shravan refuses to accept Suman's advice to him. Watch the episode to know the advice that Shravan couldn't accept.

episodesList.title: What Does Shravan Tell Devika?
episodesList.summary: Shravan confronts Devika and tells her the things he doesn't like about her. How will Devika react to this?

episodesList.title: Devika Offends Devraj
episodesList.summary: When Devraj meets Devika after the PTA, he is offended by her behaviour. He then asks Shravan to concentrate on his studies. Will Shravan continue his relationship with Devika?

episodesList.title: Sharavan Caught in a Girls' Competition
episodesList.summary: Shravan gets beaten up by a teacher when he is caught at a debate competition held only for girls. What was Shravan doing at that competition?

episodesList.title: Devika Is Upset
episodesList.summary: Suman feels sorry for Shravan, who has been punished. Devraj and Vijay have come to the school for a meeting and Devraj feels embarrassed on seeing Shravan being punished. Shravan apologizes to Suman for embarrassing her. Devika overhears their conversation and gets upset. Aneesh asks Devika to persuade Suman so that she can convince Shravan to attend the party. Later in the night, Shravan visits Suman and realizes that she is the one for him.

episodesList.title: Shravan-Devika’s Break Up
episodesList.summary: Shravan breaks up with Devika and wants to celebrate his freedom with Suman by going out for a bike ride. Will Suman agree?

episodesList.title: Suman Rejects Shravan’s Offer
episodesList.summary: Suman rejects Shravan's offer of going to the party with him. But she goes to the party, looking stunning. Will Shravan show up at the party?

episodesList.title: Will Devika’s Plan Succeed?
episodesList.summary: Devika and Aneesh are wondering if Sharavan would come for the party or not? For their plan to work, it's imperative that he comes. Will Shravan come for the party?

episodesList.title: Aneesh Successfully Traps Shravan
episodesList.summary: Aneesh and Devika gather everyone around in the party to expose Shravans lie about Sumans crush on him. When Suman learns this she feels broken. In the meantime, Devika grabs the opportunity and puts the cake on Shravans face to get her revenge. Later, Shravan tries to explain himself to Suman but Kanchan does not let him.

episodesList.title: Kanchan and Aneesh Team Up
episodesList.summary: Kanchan decides to team up with Aneesh and his friends, to teach Shravan a lesson. She calls Shravan and his parents at her house and plans to expose Shravan in front of them.

episodesList.title: Suman Saves Shravan Again
episodesList.summary: When Suman tries to call Shravan, he keeps rejecting her calls in fear. Finally, Suman seeks Bunty's help to talk to Shravan and explains to him that they haven't told anything to his parents. Shravan is amused to see Suman helping him again.

episodesList.title: Shravan Upsets Suman
episodesList.summary: Shravan offers something to Suman, but she accidentally hits his forehead while declining the offer. Shravan thinks that Suman would partner up with him for the Buddy Project. But Suman disagrees. On the day of the presentation, Suman fails the project and the principal of the school is disappointed. Shravan, on the other hand, appreciates Suman and talks about the things that he has learned after knowing her.

episodesList.title: Bhopali’s Suggestion
episodesList.summary: Suman is adamant about not forgiving Shravan. Bhopali has a suggestion for Shravan to impress Suman. This suggestion involves Shravan donating blood at a blood camp. Will Shravan overcome his fear of needles to impress Suman?

episodesList.title: Head Over Heels
episodesList.summary: While Shravan holds deep love for Suman in his heart, their respective fathers are at loggerheads. Also Suman's feelings do not coincide with Shravan's. Will Shravan's love succeed? On what grounds do the fathers get into a tiff? Watch this episode to get the details.

episodesList.title: Minding Fathers
episodesList.summary: When all attempts of Suman and Shravan to get their fathers befriended fail, they come up with a plan. Will this plan succeed or is this the beginning of new hassles? Don't forget to watch this episode.

episodesList.title: Group Study
episodesList.summary: On one hand, Shravan gets excited to join the group study batch. On the other hand, his efforts to convince Devraj and Vijay's families to come to terms fall flat. What is the reason behind Shravan's excitement? Will he succeed in bringing the families together? Watch this eventful episode to know.

episodesList.title: Trust Your Friends
episodesList.summary: When Shravan reaches late at the study group, Suman gets stunned to see him. However, things get out of hand when Daddu asks Shravan to place his trust in Aneesh. As Shravan fails to do so, Daddu insultingly scolds him and throws him out of the house. Afraid that this incident might reach his Parents. Shravan puts his trust in Suman to sort the matter out. Find out what happens next in this episode.

episodesList.title: Sharp Suman
episodesList.summary: Shravan is at the receiving end of misbehaviour from Suman's grandfather. This brings about bitterness between the two families yet again. Suman has a bright idea up her sleeve to make things better between the two parties. Will her plan work? Will Shravan come around? Watch this episode to understand.

episodesList.title: Wake Up, Shravan
episodesList.summary: Shravan shocks his family when he expresses a desire to attend the study group. Devraj and Kavita advise him to ignore any insults he may face and Shravan agrees and leaves for the study group. Daddu, Aneesh, Devika, Vijay and Suman are happy for Shravan. Although Shravan performs well in the first-day task, he is terrified with the next task of meeting at 5 am for the study group. Suman, Devraj and Avani refuse to help him. Will Shravan make it to the second task? Will he wake up on time? Catch all the interesting events in this episode.

episodesList.title: The Wake-Up Plan
episodesList.summary: Shravan wants to reach on time for the study group. So, he tries different ways like staying up all night, setting four different alarms and so on. But his efforts are sabotaged by Avani. And despite all his efforts to be on time, Suman discovers him sleeping in his father's car. Daddu scolds him and decides to punish him for his mistake. He asks Suman to come up with a punishment for Shravan. Will Suman be on Shravan's side or against him? Watch this dramatic episode, to find out.

episodesList.title: The Army Quiz
episodesList.summary: Shravan freaks out when he learns that Vijay and Daddu are about to put the group through an army test. The other members of the study group prepare for the test, while Shravan dozes off in Suman's lap. When Daddu learns about his misbehaviour, he insults Shravan's uncle in the committee meeting. What will Shravan do now? Watch this mind-blowing episode to know.

episodesList.title: Shravan Raises the Bar
episodesList.summary: The army test and his lack of confidence, had left Shravan in a state of tizzy. Daddu even insults Shravan's uncle. So, Shravan decides to step up and dig his feet. This leads him to win everyone's hearts. Especially Vijay and Suman. He impresses everyone with his immaculate knowledge about the Army and his super impressive talks. Watch how things turn around for the better, as Shravan levels up his game.

episodesList.title: The Mounting Pressure
episodesList.summary: Though Shravan has succeeded in winning everyone's hearts with his Army talks, he doesn't know what challenge awaits him next. Shravan's mother insists that the study group should conduct the study at their place or else Shravan has to walk out from the study group. Will Suman get to know about this and help him out? Or, will Shravan have to leave the study group?  Watch what unfolds next in Shravan's life!

episodesList.title: Shravan's Dangling Fate
episodesList.summary: Shravan's well-progressing life is met with a hurdle when his mother insists upon having the study group come over to their place to carry out the activity. Though Shravan promised his mother, he is now in a fix as to how he should convince them. He begs a plea to Suman to help him out. Suman readily agrees and goes out on a limb to convince the family. Watch this episode to see if Suman and Shravan's partnership in accomplishing the plan is a successful one or not.

episodesList.title: A Good Day Gone Bad
episodesList.summary: Shravan wanted the study group to visit his place. Suman makes this happen, and Devraj and Kavita are very happy to see everyone. Suman saves Shravan from being insulted in front of his mother. However, when Aneesh informs Suman that Shravan is spying on her, Suman gets furious. Moreover, Rajendra's words don't sit well with the family and they leave fuming in anger. How will things take a turn for Shravan from here on? Will Suman give him a chance?

episodesList.title: The Feud Continues
episodesList.summary: When Suman's family comes over to Shravan's place, things go downhill. Suman is not only furious about how things go with Daddu but the spying story too. Owing to which she distances herself from Shravan. When Shravan finds out how Daddu was insulted, he decides to confront Suman and tell her everything. But when he tries to reach out to her, the message reaches someone else. Who is it? What will Shravan do when he finds out that Suman did not get his message? Tune into this episode.

episodesList.title: Shravan Sets Things Right
episodesList.summary: Sharvan's life has been full of ups and downs. After the recent fiasco at his place, he tries to iron things out between him and Suman. However, she is hesitant. At the other end, Shravan's mother is really upset about things and refuses to eat. Shravan decides to churn a lovely surprise for his mother. He gets her a wonderful outfit and even cooks a delicious meal. Will Shravan's efforts be fruitful in warming up his mother's heart? Will she embrace his lovely gesture? Tune in to find out.

episodesList.title: What's Brewing, Daddu?
episodesList.summary: After hearing Shravan talk, Daddu is certain about having the Malhotras over. For the same purpose, he organizes a lunch. He doesn't inform anyone about it and is completely zipped about what's on his mind. He uses his commissioning day anniversary as an excuse for organizing the lunch. While Devraj and Shravan are happy with the news, suspicion sprouts in Rajendra's mind. What is Daddu's motive behind this? What will unfold next for the Malhotras? Tune into this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Luncheon
episodesList.summary: Daddu decides to extend a lunch invitation to Devraj. However, this lunch invitation seems to have an agenda covered in it. Furthermore, what is surprising is that Devraj's family is totally in darkness about this strange invite. Watch this episode to find out what happens in this lunch get together.

episodesList.title: Friends Forever
episodesList.summary: Suman and Shravan make a promise to each other - the promise of their friendship to last for an entire life. Additionally, they also try hard to make their fathers come to terms with each other. Will Suman and Shravan succeed in their quest?
